package evals_test

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow"
)

func status(t *testing.T, root string) workflow.StatusReport {
	t.Helper()
	r, err := workflow.Status(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Status: %v", err)
	}
	return r
}

func statusEntry(t *testing.T, r workflow.StatusReport, numberedSlug string) workflow.StatusEntry {
	t.Helper()
	for _, entry := range r.Queue {
		if strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(entry.Path), ".md") == numberedSlug {
			return entry
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("Status queue has no %s: %#v", numberedSlug, r.Queue)
	return workflow.StatusEntry{}
}

func waiting(t *testing.T, r workflow.StatusReport, slug, on, rule string) {
	t.Helper()
	e := statusEntry(t, r, slug)
	if e.WaitingOn != on || e.WaitingRule != rule {
		t.Errorf("%s waiting = %q/%q, want %q/%q", slug, e.WaitingOn, e.WaitingRule, on, rule)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_101_FLOW_102_FLOW_103_StatusQueueAndForwardWaiting(t *testing.T) {
	root := eligibilityBase(t, "alpha")
	eligibilityChange(t, root, 2, "same", "alpha", "", "")
	eligibilityChange(t, root, 3, "direct", "beta", "", "")
	eligibilityChange(t, root, 4, "transitive", "gamma", "", "")
	eligibilityChange(t, root, 5, "free", "delta", "", "")
	eligibilityChange(t, root, 6, "also-blocked", "beta", "", "")
	readyEligibilityFixture(t, root)
	freeFile := readFile(t, root, "changes/0005-free.md")
	write(t, root, "changes/0005-free.md", strings.Replace(freeFile, "module: delta\n", "module: delta\nphase: audit\naudit_rounds: 2\n", 1))
	blockedFile := readFile(t, root, "changes/0006-also-blocked.md")
	write(t, root, "changes/0006-also-blocked.md", strings.Replace(blockedFile, "module: beta\n", "module: beta\nblocked: separately blocked\n", 1))
	r := status(t, root)
	q, err := project.Queue(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(r.Queue) != len(q) {
		t.Fatalf("queue length = %d, want %d", len(r.Queue), len(q))
	}
	for i, ch := range q {
		e := r.Queue[i]
		if e.Slug != ch.Slug || e.Path != ch.Path || e.Module != ch.Module {
			t.Errorf("queue[%d] identity = %#v, want %#v", i, e, ch)
		}
	}
	blocked := statusEntry(t, r, "0001-manual")
	if blocked.Phase != "impl" || blocked.Blocked != "fixture blocked" || blocked.AuditRounds != 0 {
		t.Errorf("blocked state = %#v", blocked)
	}
	free := statusEntry(t, r, "0005-free")
	if free.Phase != "audit" || free.Blocked != "" || free.AuditRounds != 2 {
		t.Errorf("authored state = %#v", free)
	}
	if same := statusEntry(t, r, "0002-same"); same.Phase != "queued" || same.Blocked != "" || same.AuditRounds != 0 {
		t.Errorf("default state = %#v", same)
	}
	waiting(t, r, "0001-manual", "", "")
	waiting(t, r, "0002-same", "0001-manual", "same_module")
	waiting(t, r, "0003-direct", "0001-manual", "depends_on_blocked")
	waiting(t, r, "0004-transitive", "0001-manual", "depends_on_blocked")
	waiting(t, r, "0005-free", "", "")
	waiting(t, r, "0006-also-blocked", "", "")
}

func Test_FLOW_104_FLOW_105_StatusInterfaceAndProjectedWaiting(t *testing.T) {
	root := eligibilityBase(t, "gamma")
	eligibilityChange(t, root, 2, "interface-direct", "beta", "", "Beta API changes.\n")

	waiting(t, r, "0005-internal-transitive", "", "")

	waiting(t, r, "0005-own-remove", "", "")
}

func Test_FLOW_106_FLOW_107_FLOW_108_StatusModuleMetadata(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	alpha := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")
	alpha = strings.Replace(alpha, "depends_on: []\n", "depends_on: []\nboundaries_opt_out: approved fixture exception\n", 1)
	alpha = strings.Replace(alpha, "### ALP-002\n", "### ALP-002 [quarantine: intermittent fixture]\n", 1)
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md", alpha)
	write(t, root, "packages/delta/SPEC.md", "---\nname: delta\nid_prefix: DEL\ndepends_on: []\n---\n# Delta\n\n## Specs\n\n### DEL-001 [quarantine: unavailable service]\nDelta MUST work.\n")
	commit(t, root, "module metadata")
	snapshot, err := project.Load(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r := status(t, root)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.Modules, snapshot.Modules) {
		t.Errorf("modules = %#v, want discovered %#v", r.Modules, snapshot.Modules)
	}
	byName := map[string]project.Module{}
	for _, m := range r.Modules {
		byName[m.Name] = m
	}
	if len(byName) != 4 || byName["alpha"].IDPrefix != "ALP" || byName["alpha"].Dir != "packages/alpha" || !reflect.DeepEqual(byName["gamma"].DependsOn, []string{"beta"}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(byName["beta"].Zones.Interface, []string{"api.go"}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(byName["alpha"].Zones.Disposable, []string{"internal/**"}) {
		t.Errorf("discovered identity/dependencies/zones = %#v", byName)
	}
	wantQ := []workflow.Quarantine{{Module: "alpha", ID: "ALP-002", Reason: "intermittent fixture"}, {Module: "delta", ID: "DEL-001", Reason: "unavailable service"}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.Quarantines, wantQ) {
		t.Errorf("quarantines = %#v, want %#v", r.Quarantines, wantQ)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.BoundaryOptOuts, []workflow.BoundaryOptOut{{Module: "alpha", Reason: "approved fixture exception"}}) {
		t.Errorf("opt-outs = %#v", r.BoundaryOptOuts)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_110_StatusSharedBaseUsesSameArchivedDocumentIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	pendingBase := head(t, root)
	git(t, root, "checkout", "-b", "feature")
	git(t, root, "checkout", "main")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "changes/archive"), 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	git(t, root, "mv", "changes/0001-manual.md", "changes/archive/0001-manual.md")
	mainArchive := readFile(t, root, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md")
	write(t, root, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md", strings.Replace(mainArchive, "module: alpha\n", "module: alpha\nphase: applied\n", 1))
	commit(t, root, "base has applied manual document")
	approved := head(t, root)
	git(t, root, "checkout", "feature")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "changes/archive"), 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	git(t, root, "mv", "changes/0001-manual.md", "changes/archive/0001-manual.md")
	change := readFile(t, root, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md")
	write(t, root, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md", strings.Replace(change, "module: alpha\n", "module: alpha\nphase: applied\n", 1))
	archivedImpl(t, root, "0002-extra", "beta", "2026-06-10T12:00:00Z")
	commit(t, root, "one approved and one new archive")
	if got := status(t, root).Unapproved; got != 1 {
		t.Errorf("local base unapproved = %d, want 1", got)
	}
	git(t, root, "update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/main", head(t, root))
	if got := status(t, root).Unapproved; got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("remote base unapproved = %d, want 0", got)
	}
	git(t, root, "update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/main", approved)
	if got := status(t, root).Unapproved; got != 1 {
		t.Errorf("shared base unapproved = %d, want 1", got)
	}
	git(t, root, "update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/main", pendingBase)
	if got := status(t, root).Unapproved; got != 1 {
		t.Errorf("pending base identity unapproved = %d, want 1", got)
	}
	config := readFile(t, root, "fireweed.yaml")
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", strings.Replace(config, "base: main\n", "base: stable\nremote: upstream\n", 1))
	git(t, root, "update-ref", "refs/heads/stable", head(t, root))
	git(t, root, "update-ref", "refs/remotes/upstream/stable", approved)
	if got := status(t, root).Unapproved; got != 1 {
		t.Errorf("configured remote/base unapproved = %d, want 1", got)
	}
	git(t, root, "update-ref", "-d", "refs/remotes/upstream/stable")
	if got := status(t, root).Unapproved; got != 0 {
		t.Errorf("configured local fallback unapproved = %d, want 0", got)
	}
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", strings.Replace(config, "base: main\n", "", 1))
	git(t, root, "update-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/stable", approved)
	git(t, root, "symbolic-ref", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD", "refs/remotes/origin/stable")
	if got := status(t, root).Unapproved; got != 1 {
		t.Errorf("default base via origin/HEAD unapproved = %d, want 1", got)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_113_StatusLatestRecordedCostsAndSavedWarnings(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "audit:\n  enabled: false\nbudgets:\n  eval_ratio: 1\n", "", "", "", "")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/weight.txt", "one\ntwo\n")
	commit(t, root, "cost fixture")
	start(t, root)
	if _, err := done(root); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/ready", "ready\n")
	if _, err := verify(root, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapshots, err := workflow.Costs(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	latest := map[string]workflow.ModuleCost{}
	var latestAlphaB03, olderAlphaB03 project.Diagnostic
	var hasLatestAlphaB03, hasOlderAlphaB03 bool
	for _, s := range snapshots {
		for _, c := range s.Modules {
			latest[c.Module] = c
			if c.Module == "alpha" {
				olderAlphaB03, hasOlderAlphaB03 = latestAlphaB03, hasLatestAlphaB03
				latestAlphaB03, hasLatestAlphaB03 = warningFor(s.Diagnostics, "B03")
			}
		}
	}
	if !hasOlderAlphaB03 || !hasLatestAlphaB03 || olderAlphaB03 == latestAlphaB03 {
		t.Fatalf("cost snapshots need distinct older and latest alpha B03 warnings: %#v", snapshots)
	}
	config := readFile(t, root, "fireweed.yaml")
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", strings.Replace(config, "eval_ratio: 1", "eval_ratio: 100", 1))
	r := status(t, root)
	if len(r.Costs) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("cost modules = %#v, want only measured alpha and beta", r.Costs)
	}
	for _, c := range r.Costs {
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(c, latest[c.Module]) {
			t.Errorf("latest %s cost = %#v, want %#v", c.Module, c, latest[c.Module])
		}
	}
	for _, module := range []string{"alpha", "beta"} {
		want := latest[module]
		got, ok := costFor(r.Costs, module)
		if !ok || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Errorf("recorded %s cost = %#v (present %t), want %#v", module, got, ok, want)
		}
	}
	if _, ok := costFor(r.Costs, "gamma"); ok {
		t.Errorf("unmeasured gamma has cost: %#v", r.Costs)
	}
	if d, ok := warningFor(r.Diagnostics, "B03"); !ok || !d.Warning || d != latestAlphaB03 {
		t.Errorf("selected B03 warning = %#v, want %#v", r.Diagnostics, latestAlphaB03)
	}
	if containsDiagnostic(r.Diagnostics, olderAlphaB03) {
		t.Errorf("older B03 warning returned: %#v", r.Diagnostics)
	}
	count := 0
	for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
		if d.Code == "B03" {
			count++
		}
	}
	if count != 1 {
		t.Errorf("selected B03 warning count = %d, want 1: %#v", count, r.Diagnostics)
	}
}

func containsDiagnostic(ds []project.Diagnostic, want project.Diagnostic) bool {
	for _, d := range ds {
		if d == want {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
package evals_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow"
)

func prBody(t *testing.T, root, revisionRange string) workflow.PRBodyReport {
	t.Helper()
	r, err := workflow.PRBody(root, revisionRange)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("PRBody(%q): %v", revisionRange, err)
	}
	return r
}

func prRequire(t *testing.T, body string, terms ...string) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, term := range terms {
		if !strings.Contains(body, term) {
			t.Errorf("PR body lacks %q:\n%s", term, body)
		}
	}
}

func prReject(t *testing.T, body string, terms ...string) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, term := range terms {
		if strings.Contains(body, term) {
			t.Errorf("PR body unexpectedly contains %q:\n%s", term, body)
		}
	}
}

func prPhase(t *testing.T, root, phase string) {
	t.Helper()
	path := "changes/0001-manual.md"
	before := readFile(t, root, path)
	after := before
	for _, old := range []string{"evals", "audit", "impl"} {
		if strings.Contains(after, "phase: "+old+"\n") {
			after = strings.Replace(after, "phase: "+old+"\n", "phase: "+phase+"\n", 1)
			break
		}
	}
	if after == before {
		t.Fatalf("fixture phase missing in %s", path)
	}
	write(t, root, path, after)
}

// The earlier phase commits stay reachable when the requested range contains
// only the final implementation commit. The final commit also archives the
// selected identity, as a real Done does.
func prHistoryFixture(t *testing.T) (root, base, finalPhase, endpoint string) {
	t.Helper()
	root = fixture(t, "worker_writable: [workspace.lock]\n", "", "### ALP-003 [review]\nAdded review clause MUST be inspected.\n", "", "")
	alpha := readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")
	alpha = strings.Replace(alpha, "depends_on: []\n", "depends_on: []\npreserve: [internal/keep.go]\n", 1)
	alpha = strings.Replace(alpha, "### ALP-002\n", "### ALP-002 [review]\n", 1)
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md", alpha)
	manual := readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "### ALP-001\n", "### ALP-001 [review]\n", 1)
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "module: alpha\n", "module: alpha\nphase: evals\nrun: pr-fixture\naudit_rounds: 0\n", 1)
	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", manual)
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/keep.go", "package alpha // preserved baseline\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/existing.go", "package alpha // existing disposable\n")
	write(t, root, "changes/0003-outside.md", "---\nmodule: gamma\n---\n\n## Motivation\nOutside range change.\n\n## Interface\n\n## Added\n\n## Modified\n\n## Removed\n\n## Decisions\n\n")
	write(t, root, "changes/0004-removed.md", "---\nmodule: beta\n---\n\n## Motivation\nRemoved identity.\n\n## Interface\n\n## Added\n\n## Modified\n\n## Removed\n\n## Decisions\n\n")
	commit(t, root, "fixture phase base")
	base = head(t, root)

	// Evals: an interface edit, one new disposable stub, an eval file, a
	// module manifest, an ordinary module file and a shared writable lockfile.
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/api.go", "package alpha // RANGE INTERFACE EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/report_test.go", "package alpha_test // RANGE EVAL EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/new_stub.go", "package alpha // RANGE STUB ADDITION\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/go.mod", "module fixture.invalid/alpha\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/other.txt", "RANGE OTHER EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "workspace.lock", "RANGE SHARED EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "changes/0002-pending.md", "---\nmodule: beta\neval_fix: [BET-001]\nphase: audit\nrun: beta-pr-fixture\naudit_rounds: 0\n---\n\n## Motivation\nSelected pending identity.\n\n## Interface\n\n## Added\n\n## Modified\n\n## Removed\n\n## Decisions\n\n## Provenance\n- evals 2026-10-30T12:00:00Z tests=7 failing=2 passing=5\n")
	manual = readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "phase: evals\n", "phase: audit\n", 1)
	manual += "\n## Provenance\n- evals 2026-10-30T12:00:00Z tests=11 failing=3 passing=8\n"
	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", manual)
	commit(t, root, "evals phase with selected pending change")

	manual = readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "phase: audit\n", "phase: evals\n", 1)
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "audit_rounds: 0\n", "audit_rounds: 1\n", 1)
	manual += "\n## Audit\n- ALP-001: \"" + newClause + "\" — PRIOR AUDIT FINDING missing assertion\n"
	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", manual)
	commit(t, root, "audit finding round one")

	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/report_test.go", "package alpha_test // CORRECTED EVAL EDIT\n")
	prPhase(t, root, "audit")
	commit(t, root, "corrected eval phase")

	manual = readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "phase: audit\n", "phase: impl\n", 1)
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "\n## Audit\n- ALP-001: \""+newClause+"\" — PRIOR AUDIT FINDING missing assertion\n", "\n## Audit\nNo findings\nChecked IDs: ALP-001\n", 1)
	write(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md", manual)
	commit(t, root, "clean audit phase")
	finalPhase = head(t, root)

	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/keep.go", "package alpha // PRESERVED IMPLEMENTATION EDIT\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/existing.go", "package alpha // IMPLEMENTATION EDIT\n")
	manual = readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	manual = strings.Replace(manual, "phase: impl\n", "phase: applied\n", 1)
	manual += "- impl 2026-10-30T12:30:00Z tests=13 failing=0 passing=13\n"
	write(t, root, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md", manual)
	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0001-manual.md")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "changes/0004-removed.md")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	commit(t, root, "implementation and archive")
	endpoint = head(t, root)
	return
}

func Test_FLOW_114_FLOW_115_FLOW_116_FLOW_117_FLOW_118_FLOW_119_FLOW_120_FLOW_121_PRBodySelectedHistoryAndEndpoint(t *testing.T) {
	root, base, finalPhase, endpoint := prHistoryFixture(t)
	// Later committed and dirty edits must not change the requested endpoint.
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", strings.Replace(readFile(t, root, "fireweed.yaml"), "modules: [\"packages/*\"]", "modules: [] # LATER HEAD CONFIG MARKER", 1))
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md", readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")+"\nLATER HEAD SPEC MARKER\n")
	commit(t, root, "later unrelated HEAD")
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", readFile(t, root, "fireweed.yaml")+"\n# DIRTY WORKTREE CONFIG MARKER\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md", readFile(t, root, "packages/alpha/SPEC.md")+"\nDIRTY WORKTREE SPEC MARKER\n")
	full := base + ".." + endpoint
	partial := finalPhase + ".." + endpoint
	t.Run("FLOW_114_explicit_endpoints", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, full)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, base[:12], endpoint[:12])
		prReject(t, r.Body, "LATER HEAD CONFIG MARKER", "LATER HEAD SPEC MARKER", "DIRTY WORKTREE CONFIG MARKER", "DIRTY WORKTREE SPEC MARKER")
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_115_selected_identities", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, full)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md", "alpha", "changes/0002-pending.md", "beta", "eval_fix")
		prReject(t, r.Body, "0003-outside", "0004-removed")
		p := prBody(t, root, partial)
		prRequire(t, p.Body, "changes/archive/0001-manual.md")
		prReject(t, p.Body, "0002-pending.md")
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_116_provenance_and_evals", func(t *testing.T) {
		fullReport := prBody(t, root, full)
		prRequire(t, fullReport.Body, "tests=7", "failing=2", "passing=5")
		for _, rr := range []string{full, partial} {
			r := prBody(t, root, rr)
			prRequire(t, r.Body, "tests=11", "failing=3", "passing=8", "report_test.go")
		}
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_117_phase_file_categories", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, rr := range []string{full, partial} {
			r := prBody(t, root, rr)
			prRequire(t, r.Body, "api.go", "new_stub.go", "go.mod", "other.txt", "workspace.lock")
		}
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_118_preserved_edits", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, full)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "keep.go")
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_119_review_specs", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, rr := range []string{full, partial} {
			r := prBody(t, root, rr)
			prRequire(t, r.Body, "ALP-003", "Added review clause MUST be inspected.", "ALP-001", newClause)
			prReject(t, r.Body, "Alpha MUST retain the second behavior.")
		}
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_120_prior_corrected_audit", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, rr := range []string{full, partial} {
			r := prBody(t, root, rr)
			prRequire(t, r.Body, "PRIOR AUDIT FINDING")
			if !strings.Contains(r.Body, "audit_rounds") && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(r.Body), "audit rounds") {
				t.Errorf("PR body omits audit round count: %s", r.Body)
			}
		}
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_121_decisions", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, full)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "Use the revised policy.", "Retain old policy.")
	})
}

	endpoint := head(t, root)
	old := workflow.CostSnapshot{Run: "old", Phase: "evals", RecordedAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 29, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Modules: []workflow.ModuleCost{{Module: "alpha", Seconds: 99, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{"ALP-001": 99}, EvalLines: 99, DisposableLines: 1}}, Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{{Code: "B01", Message: "OLD B01", Warning: true}}}
	latest := workflow.CostSnapshot{Run: "new", Phase: "impl", RecordedAt: time.Date(2026, 10, 30, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), Modules: []workflow.ModuleCost{{Module: "alpha", Seconds: 4.25, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{"ALP-001": 5}, EvalLines: 17, DisposableLines: 3}, {Module: "beta", Seconds: 2.5, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{"BET-001": 2}, EvalLines: 8, DisposableLines: 4}}, Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{{Code: "B01", Message: "SAVED B01 time", Warning: true}, {Code: "B02", Message: "ALP-001: SAVED B02 cases", Warning: true}, {Code: "B03", Message: "alpha: SAVED B03 ratio", Warning: true}}}
	prSaveCost(t, root, "old", "evals", old)
	prSaveCost(t, root, "new", "impl", latest)
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", readFile(t, root, "fireweed.yaml")+"\nbudgets:\n  cases_per_spec: 1000\n  eval_ratio: 1000\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/later.txt", strings.Repeat("later\n", 50))
	t.Run("FLOW_122_endpoint_exceptions", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, base+".."+endpoint)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "alpha", "ALP-002", "ENDPOINT QUARANTINE REASON", "ENDPOINT OPT OUT REASON", "0001-manual", "ENDPOINT BLOCK REASON")
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_123_latest_saved_costs", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, base+".."+endpoint)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "SAVED B01", "SAVED B02", "SAVED B03")
		prReject(t, r.Body, "OLD B01")
		section := regexp.MustCompile(`(?ms)^#{1,6} (?:Cost|Costs|Metric|Metrics)\s*\n(.*?)(?:^#{1,6} |\z)`).FindStringSubmatch(r.Body)
		if len(section) != 2 {
			t.Errorf("PR body lacks a Cost/Metric section: %s", r.Body)
		} else {
			rows := regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^\|\s*(?:alpha|beta|gamma)\s*\|[^\n]*$`).FindAllString(section[1], -1)
			want := map[string]string{
				"alpha": "alpha|4.25|ALP-001: 5|17|3",
				"beta":  "beta|2.5|BET-001: 2|8|4",
			}
			seen := map[string]bool{}
			for _, row := range rows {
				cells := strings.Split(strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(row), "|"), "|")
				for i := range cells {
					cells[i] = strings.TrimSpace(cells[i])
				}
				module := cells[0]
				if seen[module] || strings.Join(cells, "|") != want[module] {
					t.Errorf("unexpected or stale cost measurement row %q", row)
				}
				seen[module] = true
			}
			for module := range want {
				if !seen[module] {
					t.Errorf("missing saved %s cost measurement row: %s", module, section[1])
				}
			}
		}
		for _, code := range []string{"B01", "B02", "B03"} {
			if !containsCode(r.Diagnostics, code) {
				t.Errorf("PRBody diagnostics lack saved %s: %#v", code, r.Diagnostics)
			}
		}
	})
}

func Test_FLOW_126_PRBodyEndpointConfigError(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	base := head(t, root)
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", "[invalid endpoint configuration\n")
	commit(t, root, "invalid endpoint configuration")

	_, err := workflow.PRBody(root, base+".."+head(t, root))
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("PRBody accepted malformed endpoint configuration")
	}
	if !workflow.IsEndpointConfigError(err) {
		t.Errorf("IsEndpointConfigError(%v) = false, want true", err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_127_PRBodyUnresolvableRangeIsNotEndpointConfigError(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	_, err := workflow.PRBody(root, head(t, root)+"..not-a-commit")
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("PRBody accepted an unresolvable range")
	}
	if workflow.IsEndpointConfigError(err) {
		t.Errorf("IsEndpointConfigError(%v) = true, want false", err)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_124_FLOW_125_PRBodyDisposableArtifactBoundaryAndRanges(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	base := head(t, root)
	for path, data := range map[string][]byte{
		"packages/alpha/internal/binary.dat": {0, 1, 2, 3},
		"packages/alpha/internal/large.txt":  []byte(strings.Repeat("L", 262145)),
		"packages/alpha/internal/exact.txt":  []byte(strings.Repeat("E", 262144)),
		"packages/alpha/internal/small.txt":  []byte("ordinary text\n"),
	} {
		full := filepath.Join(root, path)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(full, data, 0644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	commit(t, root, "new disposable artifacts")
	endpoint := head(t, root)
	t.Run("FLOW_124_binary_and_large_artifacts", func(t *testing.T) {
		r := prBody(t, root, base+".."+endpoint)
		prRequire(t, r.Body, "binary.dat", "large.txt", "262145", "B04")
		if !regexp.MustCompile("(?m)(binary\\.dat[^\\n]*\\b4\\b|\\b4\\b[^\\n]*binary\\.dat)").MatchString(r.Body) {
			t.Errorf("binary artifact lacks its 4-byte size: %s", r.Body)
		}
		count := 0
		for _, d := range r.Diagnostics {
			if d.Code == "B04" {
				count++
				if !d.Warning || !(strings.Contains(d.Message, "binary.dat") || strings.Contains(d.Message, "large.txt")) || strings.Contains(d.Message, "exact.txt") || strings.Contains(d.Message, "small.txt") {
					t.Errorf("unexpected B04 diagnostic: %#v", d)
				}
			}
		}
		if count != 2 {
			t.Errorf("B04 count = %d, want 2: %#v", count, r.Diagnostics)
		}
	})
	t.Run("FLOW_125_empty_and_invalid_ranges", func(t *testing.T) {
		empty := prBody(t, root, endpoint+".."+endpoint)
		if strings.TrimSpace(empty.Body) == "" || !(strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(empty.Body), "none") || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(empty.Body), "no change")) {
			t.Errorf("empty range did not explicitly report no selected changes: %q", empty.Body)
		}
		if containsCode(empty.Diagnostics, "B04") {
			t.Errorf("empty range yielded B04: %#v", empty.Diagnostics)
		}
		for _, invalid := range []string{"", "not-a-commit.." + endpoint, base + "..not-a-commit", "not-a-range"} {
			_, err := workflow.PRBody(root, invalid)
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "P01") || (invalid != "" && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not-a-commit") && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not-a-range") && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "resolve")) {
				t.Errorf("PRBody(%q) error = %v, want P01 with rejected range or cause", invalid, err)
			}
		}
	})
}

func start(root, selector string, attempt int, resume bool) (model.State, error) {
	r, e := canonical(root)
	if e != nil {
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	var ch project.Change
	if selector != "" {
		ch, e = selectChange(r, selector, false)
		if e != nil {
			return model.State{}, e
		}
	}
	if resume {
		if attempt <= 0 {
			return model.State{}, code("P01", "invalid attempt %d", attempt)
		}
		name := "refs/fireweed/attempts/" + ch.Slug + "/" + strconv.Itoa(attempt)
		_, ok, re := gitstore.Ref(r, name)
		if re != nil {
			return model.State{}, re
		}
		if !ok {
			return model.State{}, code("P01", "attempt %s not found", name)
		}
	}
	isDirty, e := dirty(r)
	if e != nil {
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	if isDirty {
		return model.State{}, code("P01", "start requires clean worktree")
	}
	eligible, e := Eligible(r)
	if e != nil {
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	if len(eligible) == 0 {
		return model.State{}, code("P01", "no eligible change")
	}
	if selector == "" {
		ch = eligible[0]
	} else if ch.Path != eligible[0].Path {
		return model.State{}, code("P01", "change is not eligible queue head")
	}
	if c, _, ok, re := readClaim(r, ch); re != nil {
		return model.State{}, re
	} else if ok {
		return model.State{}, code("P02", "claim already held: %s: update-ref", c.Worktree)
	}
	head, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
	if e != nil {
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	original, e := textFile(r, ch.Path)
	if e != nil {
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	s := original
	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
	if e != nil {
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	if resume && frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]) == "" {
		return model.State{}, code("P01", "attempt requires committed phase")
	}
	if !resume {
		if e = validateBases(r, ch); e != nil {
			return model.State{}, e
		}
		s, e = assignIDs(r, ch, s)
		if e != nil {
			return model.State{}, e
		}
		doc, e = contracts.ParseDocument(s)
		if e != nil {
			return model.State{}, e
		}
	}
	phase := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"])
	run := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["run"])
	if phase == "" {
		phase = "evals"
		if len(ch.Added)+len(ch.Modified)+len(ch.Removed) == 0 && len(list(doc.Frontmatter["fixes"])) == 0 && len(list(doc.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) == 0 {
			phase = "impl"
		}
		if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
			phase = "impl"
		}
	}
	if run == "" {
		run = runID()
	}
	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
	doc.Frontmatter["run"] = run
	s, e = render(doc)
	if e != nil {
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	if e = writeFile(r, ch.Path, s); e != nil {
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	snap, e := project.Project(r, ch.Slug)
	if e != nil {
		_ = writeFile(r, ch.Path, original)
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	snap.Root = r
	c := claim{Worktree: r, Change: ch.Slug, Run: run, Phase: phase, PhaseBase: head, Approved: s, Snapshot: snap}
	oid, e := saveClaim(r, ch, c, "")
	if e != nil {
		_ = writeFile(r, ch.Path, original)
		return model.State{}, e
	}
	if resume {
		e = restoreAttempt(r, ch, attempt, s)
		if e != nil {
			_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
			return model.State{}, e
		}
	} else if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
		_ = deleteDisposable(r, ch, snap)
	}
	st, e := state(r, ch, c, oid)
	if e != nil {
		return st, e
	}
	if !resume {
		base, _ := gitstore.BaseRef(r, "", "main")
		if base != "" {
			_, be := gitstore.ReadAt(r, base, ch.Path)
			if be != nil {
				st.Diagnostics = append(st.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P04", Message: "change is not on shared base", Warning: true})
			}
		}
	}
	return st, nil
}
func Start(root, selector string) (model.State, error) { return start(root, selector, 0, false) }
func StartFromAttempt(root, selector string, n int) (model.State, error) {
	return start(root, selector, n, true)
}
func validateBases(root string, ch project.Change) error {
	stale, e := project.StaleSpecs(root, ch.Slug)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	for _, s := range stale {
		if !s.Recovered {
			return code("P05", "stale base for %s", s.ID)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func assignIDs(root string, ch project.Change, s string) (string, error) {
	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
	if e != nil {
		return s, e
	}
	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Added"))
	if e != nil {
		return s, e
	}
	if len(items) == 0 {
		return s, nil
	}
	snap, e := project.Load(root)
	if e != nil {
		return s, e
	}
	prefix := ""
	used := map[int]bool{}
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		if m.Name != ch.Module {
			continue
		}
		prefix = m.IDPrefix
		for _, it := range mustItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")) {
			var n int
			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(it.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
				used[n] = true
			}
		}
	}
	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
	for _, other := range q {
		for _, it := range other.Added {
			var n int
			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(it.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
				used[n] = true
			}
		}
	}
	for _, it := range items {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(it.ID, "new:") {
			continue
		}
		n := 1
		for used[n] {
			n++
		}
		used[n] = true
		s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, it.ID, fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", prefix, n))
	}
	return s, nil
}
func section(body, name string) string    { s, _ := contracts.Section(body, name); return s }
func mustItems(s string) []contracts.Item { it, _ := contracts.ParseItems(s); return it }
func deleteDisposable(root string, ch project.Change, snap project.Snapshot) error {
	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
		if m.Name != ch.Module {
			continue
		}

				return nil
			}
			if d.IsDir() {
				return nil
			}
			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), p)
			if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones) == "disposable" {

			max := 2
			if n := frontInt(nested(c.Snapshot.Config, "audit")["max_rounds"]); n > 0 {
				max = n
			}
			if untestable || rounds >= max {
				blocked = true
				next = c.Phase

			} else {

				doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = rounds + 1
			}
		} else {

		}

	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Provenance", strings.TrimSpace(previous+"\n"+line)+"\n")
	text, e := render(doc)

func applySpec(source string, ch project.Change) (string, error) {
	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(source)
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Specs"))
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	byID := map[string]contracts.Item{}
	order := []string{}
	for _, it := range items {
		byID[it.ID] = it
		order = append(order, it.ID)
	}
	for _, it := range ch.Removed {
		delete(byID, it.ID)
	}
	for _, it := range append(ch.Modified, ch.Added...) {
		if _, ok := byID[it.ID]; !ok {
			order = append(order, it.ID)
		}
		byID[it.ID] = it
	}
	sort.Strings(order)
	unique := map[string]bool{}
	lines := []string{}
	for _, id := range order {
		if unique[id] {
			continue
		}
		unique[id] = true
		if it, ok := byID[id]; ok {
			lines = append(lines, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
		}
	}
	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", strings.Join(lines, "\n\n")+"\n")
	if set := nested(ch.Document.Frontmatter, "set"); len(set) > 0 {
		for k, v := range set {
			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
		}
	}
	decisions := strings.TrimSpace(section(doc.Body, "Decisions"))
	removed := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Removed decisions"))
	if removed != "" {
		for _, entry := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
			if entry != "" {
				decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, entry, "")
			}
		}
	}
	added := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Decisions"))
	if added != "" {
		for _, entry := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
			if entry != "" {
				if decisions != "" {
					decisions += "\n"
				}
				decisions += "- " + ch.Slug + ": " + entry
			}
		}
	}
	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n")
	return render(doc)
}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..61a525268577e7ffe33c8e223645ad63dcf2d230

@@ -0,0 +1,296 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	req.Quick = false
+	out, e := verify(ctx, req)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	before, e := textFile(root, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(before)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	next := ""
+	blocked := false
+	switch c.Phase {
+	case "evals":
+		next = "audit"
+		audit := nested(c.Snapshot.Config, "audit")
+		if enabled, ok := audit["enabled"].(bool); ok && !enabled {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+	case "audit":
+		body, untestable, ae := auditSubmission(ch, c)
+		if ae != nil {
+			return out, ae
+		}
+		doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Audit", body)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(body, "-") {
+			rounds := frontInt(doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])
+			max := 2
+			if n := frontInt(nested(c.Snapshot.Config, "audit")["max_rounds"]); n > 0 {
+				max = n
+			}
+			if untestable || rounds >= max {
+				blocked = true
+				next = c.Phase
+				doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = "audit findings"
+				doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Questions", body)
+			} else {
+				next = "evals"
+				doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = rounds + 1
+			}
+		} else {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+	case "impl":
+		next = "applied"
+	default:
+		return out, code("P01", "unsupported phase %s", c.Phase)
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = next
+	line := provenance(c, req, out.Reports)
+	previous := section(doc.Body, "Provenance")
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Provenance", strings.TrimSpace(previous+"\n"+line)+"\n")
+	text, e := render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(root, ch.Path, text); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	var specPath, specBefore string
+	if next == "applied" {
+		for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if m.Name == ch.Module {
+				specPath = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, "SPEC.md"))
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if specPath == "" {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, code("C01", "module %s missing", ch.Module)
+		}
+		specBefore, e = textFile(root, specPath)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, e
+		}
+		newSpec, ae := applySpec(specBefore, ch)
+		if ae != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, ae
+		}
+		if e = writeFile(root, specPath, newSpec); e != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, e
+		}
+		archived := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive"), 0755); e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		if e = os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, ch.Path), filepath.Join(root, archived)); e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+			if !d.Warning {
+				_ = os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, archived), filepath.Join(root, ch.Path))
+				_ = writeFile(root, specPath, specBefore)
+				_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+				return out, code(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "commit", "-m", fmt.Sprintf("fireweed %s %s", ch.Slug, c.Phase)); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	c.Phase = next
+	c.PhaseBase = head
+	c.Approved = text
+	if next == "applied" || blocked {
+		_ = releaseClaim(root, ch, oid)
+		out.State.ClaimOID = ""
+		if next == "applied" {
+			ch.Path = "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+		}
+	} else {
+		oid, e = saveClaim(root, ch, c, oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		out.State.ClaimOID = oid
+	}
+	out.State.Change = ch
+	out.State.Change.Document = doc
+	out.State.Phase = next
+	out.State.PhaseBase = head
+	out.State.Head = head
+	if blocked {
+		return out, code("P06", "change blocked")
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+func applySpec(source string, ch project.Change) (string, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(source)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Specs"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	byID := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	order := []string{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+		order = append(order, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range ch.Removed {
+		delete(byID, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range append(ch.Modified, ch.Added...) {
+		if _, ok := byID[it.ID]; !ok {
+			order = append(order, it.ID)
+		}
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+	}
+	sort.Strings(order)
+	unique := map[string]bool{}
+	lines := []string{}
+	for _, id := range order {
+		if unique[id] {
+			continue
+		}
+		unique[id] = true
+		if it, ok := byID[id]; ok {
+			lines = append(lines, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", strings.Join(lines, "\n\n")+"\n")
+	if set := nested(ch.Document.Frontmatter, "set"); len(set) > 0 {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	decisions := strings.TrimSpace(section(doc.Body, "Decisions"))
+	removed := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Removed decisions"))
+	if removed != "" {
+		for _, entry := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
+			if entry != "" {
+				decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, entry, "")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	added := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Decisions"))
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, entry := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
+			if entry != "" {
+				if decisions != "" {
+					decisions += "\n"
+				}
+				decisions += "- " + ch.Slug + ": " + entry
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n")
+	return render(doc)
+}
+
+func Context(root, selector string, full bool) (string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	ch, c, _, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	change, e := textFile(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString("# Change\n" + change + "\n# Projected spec\n")
+	for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		v, _ := render(m.Document)
+		b.WriteString(v + "\n")
+		for _, pattern := range m.Zones.Interface {
+			_ = pattern
+		}
+		_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r, m.Dir), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(r, p)
+			name := filepath.ToSlash(rel)
+			sub := strings.TrimPrefix(name, m.Dir+"/")
+			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(sub, m.Zones)
+			if zone == "interface" {
+				v, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
+				b.WriteString("\n## " + name + "\n" + string(v))
+				return nil
+			}
+			if sub == "SPEC.md" {
+				return nil
+			}
+			info, _ := d.Info()
+			if info == nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n%s %d bytes\n", name, info.Size()))
+			if full {
+				v, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
+				b.Write(v)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	system, _ := textFile(r, "SYSTEM.md")
+	b.WriteString("\n# SYSTEM\n" + system)
+	bookName := c.Phase
+	if c.Phase == "impl" && frontBool(ch.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+		bookName = "regenerate"
+	}
+	book, _ := assets.Playbook(bookName)
+	b.WriteString("\n" + book)
+	return b.String(), nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "crypto/sha256"
+ "encoding/hex"
+ "encoding/json"
+ "fmt"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "reflect"
+ "regexp"
+ "sort"
+ "strings"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func approvedCheck(root string,ch project.Change,c claim) error {
+ now,e:=textFile(root,ch.Path);if e!=nil{return e};a,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(c.Approved);if e!=nil{return e};b,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(now);if e!=nil{return e}
+ for _,key:=range []string{"run","phase"}{if !reflect.DeepEqual(a.Frontmatter[key],b.Frontmatter[key]){return code("P03","approved run or phase changed")}}
+ for _,key:=range []string{"audit_rounds","blocked"}{if !reflect.DeepEqual(a.Frontmatter[key],b.Frontmatter[key]){return code("P03","approved audit state changed")}}
+ for _,key:=range []string{"run","phase","audit_rounds","blocked"}{delete(a.Frontmatter,key);delete(b.Frontmatter,key)}
+ if !reflect.DeepEqual(a.Frontmatter,b.Frontmatter){return code("P03","approved author metadata changed")}
+ ab:=a.Body;bb:=b.Body
+ for _,key:=range []string{"Audit","Provenance","Questions"}{ab=contracts.ReplaceSection(ab,key,"");bb=contracts.ReplaceSection(bb,key,"")}
+ if strings.TrimSpace(ab)!=strings.TrimSpace(bb){return code("P03","approved author metadata changed")}
+ return nil
+}
+func zoneCheck(root string,ch project.Change,c claim)error{
+ changes,e:=gitstore.Changes(root,c.PhaseBase);if e!=nil{return e}
+ iface:=strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body,"Interface"))!=""
+ ds:=checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot:c.Snapshot,Module:ch.Module,Phase:c.Phase,ChangePath:ch.Path,Base:c.PhaseBase,InterfaceDeclared:iface,Changes:changes})
+ if len(list(ch.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"]))>0{for _,change:=range changes{path:=change.Path;if path==ch.Path{continue};ok:=false;if c.Phase=="evals"{for _,m:=range c.Snapshot.Modules{if m.Name==ch.Module&&strings.HasPrefix(path,m.Dir+"/"){rel:=strings.TrimPrefix(path,m.Dir+"/");ok=contracts.ResolveZone(rel,m.Zones)=="evals"}}};if !ok{return code("Z01","eval_fix forbids %s in %s",path,c.Phase)}}}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type claim struct {
+	Worktree  string           `json:"worktree"`
+	Change    string           `json:"change"`
+	Run       string           `json:"run"`
+	Phase     string           `json:"phase"`
+	PhaseBase string           `json:"phase_base"`
+	Approved  string           `json:"approved"`
+	Snapshot  project.Snapshot `json:"snapshot"`
+}
+
+func code(c string, f string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf(c+": "+f, args...) }
+func canonical(root string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := gitstore.Inspect(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return filepath.EvalSymlinks(r.Root)
+}
+func git(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+	c.Dir = root
+	c.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@local.invalid", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@local.invalid")
+	b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %s: %w", strings.Join(args, " "), strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), e)
+	}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
+}
+func runID() string {
+	b := make([]byte, 12)
+	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
+	return time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405") + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
+}
+func ref(ch project.Change) string { return "refs/fireweed/claims/" + ch.Slug }
+func readClaim(root string, ch project.Change) (claim, string, bool, error) {
+	oid, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(root, ref(ch))
+	if e != nil || !ok {
+		return claim{}, "", ok, e
+	}
+	b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(root, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return claim{}, "", true, e
+	}
+	var c claim
+	e = json.Unmarshal(b, &c)
+	return c, oid, true, e
+}
+func saveClaim(root string, ch project.Change, c claim, old string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := json.Marshal(c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	oid, e := gitstore.WriteBlob(root, b)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, ref(ch), old, oid); e != nil {
+		return "", code("P02", "claim already held: %v", e)
+	}
+	return oid, nil
+}
+func releaseClaim(root string, ch project.Change, oid string) error {
+	return gitstore.CASRef(root, ref(ch), oid, "")
+}
+func dirty(root string) (bool, error) {
+	s, e := git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
+	return s != "", e
+}
+func textFile(root, path string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path)))
+	return string(b), e
+}
+func writeFile(root, path, value string) error {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(p, []byte(value), 0644)
+}
+func frontString(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+func frontInt(v any) int {
+	switch n := v.(type) {
+	case int:
+		return n
+	case float64:
+		return int(n)
+	case string:
+		i, _ := strconv.Atoi(n)
+		return i
+	}
+	return 0
+}
+func frontBool(v any) bool { b, _ := v.(bool); return b }
+func list(v any) []string {
+	out := []string{}
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case []any:
+		for _, a := range x {
+			out = append(out, fmt.Sprint(a))
+		}
+	case []string:
+		return x
+	case string:
+		if x != "" {
+			out = append(out, x)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func nested(m map[string]any, k string) map[string]any { v, _ := m[k].(map[string]any); return v }
+func render(doc contracts.Document) (string, error)    { return contracts.RenderDocument(doc) }
+func updateDoc(root, path string, mutate func(*contracts.Document) error) error {
+	s, e := textFile(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = mutate(&d); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	s, e = render(d)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return writeFile(root, path, s)
+}
+func archiveQueue(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	q, e := project.Queue(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	entries, e := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive"))
+	if e != nil && !os.IsNotExist(e) {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	for _, ent := range entries {
+		if ent.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(ent.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		path := "changes/archive/" + ent.Name()
+		s, e := textFile(root, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		q = append(q, project.Change{Path: path, Slug: slug(ent.Name()), Module: frontString(d.Frontmatter["module"]), Document: d})
+	}
+	return q, nil
+}
+func slug(name string) string {
+	name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(name), ".md")
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(name, '-'); i >= 0 && i+1 < len(name) {
+		return name[i+1:]
+	}
+	return name
+}
+func selectChange(root, selector string, archive bool) (project.Change, error) {
+	var all []project.Change
+	var e error
+	if archive {
+		all, e = archiveQueue(root)
+	} else {
+		all, e = project.Queue(root)
+	}
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	valid := []string{}
+	matches := []project.Change{}
+	for _, ch := range all {
+		valid = append(valid, ch.Slug)
+		if selector == ch.Slug || selector == ch.Path || selector == filepath.Base(ch.Path) {
+			matches = append(matches, ch)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(matches) != 1 {
+		return project.Change{}, code("U02", "change %q not found or ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", "))
+	}
+	return matches[0], nil
+}
+func state(root string, ch project.Change, c claim, oid string) (model.State, error) {
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	for _, v := range q {
+		if v.Path == ch.Path {
+			ch = v
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return model.State{Change: ch, Snapshot: c.Snapshot, Run: c.Run, Phase: c.Phase, Head: head, PhaseBase: c.PhaseBase, ClaimOID: oid}, nil
+}
+func owned(root string, selector string) (project.Change, claim, string, error) {
+	var ch project.Change
+	var e error
+	if selector == "" {
+		q, qe := project.Queue(root)
+		if qe != nil {
+			return ch, claim{}, "", qe
+		}
+		for _, candidate := range q {
+			c, oid, ok, re := readClaim(root, candidate)
+			if re != nil {
+				return ch, claim{}, "", re
+			}
+			if ok && c.Worktree == root {
+				return candidate, c, oid, nil
+			}
+		}
+		return ch, claim{}, "", code("P02", "worktree holds no change")
+	}
+	ch, e = selectChange(root, selector, false)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ch, claim{}, "", e
+	}
+	c, oid, ok, e := readClaim(root, ch)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ch, c, oid, e
+	}
+	if !ok {
+		return ch, c, oid, code("P02", "change has no claim")
+	}
+	if c.Worktree != root {
+		return ch, c, oid, code("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
+	}
+	return ch, c, oid, nil
+}
+func Current(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return state(r, ch, c, oid)
+}
+func Release(root, selector string) error {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	ch, _, oid, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+}
+func depends(mods []project.Module, from, to string) bool {
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	var walk func(string) bool
+	walk = func(n string) bool {
+		if seen[n] {
+			return false
+		}
+		seen[n] = true
+		for _, m := range mods {
+			if m.Name == n {
+				for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+					if d == to || walk(d) {
+						return true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		return false
+	}
+	return walk(from)
+}
+func waiting(root string, q []project.Change, i int) (string, string) {
+	candidate := q[i]
+	if frontString(candidate.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(root, candidate.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
+		block := q[j]
+		if frontString(block.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if candidate.Module == block.Module {
+			return block.Slug, "same_module"
+		}
+		if depends(snap.Modules, candidate.Module, block.Module) {
+			return block.Slug, "depends_on_blocked"
+		}
+		iface, _ := contracts.Section(candidate.Document.Body, "Interface")
+		if strings.TrimSpace(iface) != "" && depends(snap.Modules, block.Module, candidate.Module) {
+			return block.Slug, "interface_dependency"
+		}
+	}
+	return "", ""
+}
+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []project.Change{}
+	for i, ch := range q {
+		if frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		on, _ := waiting(r, q, i)
+		if on == "" {
+			out = append(out, ch)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func start(root, selector string, attempt int, resume bool) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	var ch project.Change

+	}

+	}
+	if isDirty {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "start requires clean worktree")
+	}
+	eligible, e := Eligible(r)
+	if e != nil {

+	if len(eligible) == 0 {

+	if selector == "" {

+	}
+	if !resume {

+		if se == nil {
+			config, _ := project.Load(r)
+			max := frontInt(nested(config.Config, "authoring")["max_unapproved"])
+			if max <= 0 { max = 5 }
+			if status.Unapproved >= max {
+				return model.State{Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{{Code: "P07", Message: fmt.Sprintf("unapproved archives %d reached limit %d", status.Unapproved, max)} }}, code("P07", "unapproved archives reached limit")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if c, _, ok, re := readClaim(r, ch); re != nil {
+		return model.State{}, re
+	} else if ok {
+		return model.State{}, code("P02", "claim already held: %s: update-ref", c.Worktree)
+	}
+	head, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	original, e := textFile(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	s := original
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if resume && frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]) == "" {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "attempt requires committed phase")
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		if e = validateBases(r, ch); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		s, e = assignIDs(r, ch, s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		doc, e = contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	phase := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"])
+	run := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["run"])
+	if phase == "" {
+		phase = "evals"
+		if len(ch.Added)+len(ch.Modified)+len(ch.Removed) == 0 && len(list(doc.Frontmatter["fixes"])) == 0 && len(list(doc.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) == 0 {
+			phase = "impl"
+		}
+		if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+			phase = "impl"
+		}
+	}
+	if run == "" {
+		run = runID()
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
+	doc.Frontmatter["run"] = run
+	s, e = render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(r, ch.Path, s); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(r, ch.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		_ = writeFile(r, ch.Path, original)
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	snap.Root = r
+	c := claim{Worktree: r, Change: ch.Slug, Run: run, Phase: phase, PhaseBase: head, Approved: s, Snapshot: snap}
+	oid, e := saveClaim(r, ch, c, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		_ = writeFile(r, ch.Path, original)
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if resume {
+		e = restoreAttempt(r, ch, attempt, s)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	} else if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+		_ = deleteDisposable(r, ch, snap)
+	}
+	st, e := state(r, ch, c, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return st, e
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		config, _ := project.Load(r)
+		remote, base := frontString(config.Config["remote"]), frontString(config.Config["base"])
+		if remote == "" { remote = "origin" }; if base == "" { base = "main" }
+		local, le := gitstore.BaseRef(r, "", base)
+		shared, se := gitstore.BaseRef(r, remote, base)
+		localHas, sharedHas := false, false
+		if le == nil { _, be := gitstore.ReadAt(r, local, ch.Path); localHas = be == nil }
+		if se == nil { _, be := gitstore.ReadAt(r, shared, ch.Path); sharedHas = be == nil }
+		if !localHas && !sharedHas { st.Diagnostics = append(st.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P04", Message: "change is not on local or shared base", Warning: true}) }
+		if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) && !newerPassingDrill(r,ch.Module) { st.Diagnostics = append(st.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P10", Message: "regenerate has no newer passing drill", Warning: true}) }
+	}
+	return st, nil
+}
+func Start(root, selector string) (model.State, error) { return start(root, selector, 0, false) }
+func StartFromAttempt(root, selector string, n int) (model.State, error) {
+	return start(root, selector, n, true)
+}
+func validateBases(root string, ch project.Change) error {
+	stale, e := project.StaleSpecs(root, ch.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		if strings.Contains(e.Error(), "stale base") { return code("P05", "%v", e) }
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, s := range stale {
+		if !s.Recovered {
+			return code("P05", "stale base for %s", s.ID)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func newerPassingDrill(root,module string)bool{
+ entries,_:=os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root,"changes","archive"));latest:=time.Time{}
+ for _,entry:=range entries { s,e:=textFile(root,"changes/archive/"+entry.Name());if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(s);if e==nil&&frontString(d.Frontmatter["module"])==module {if t:=implDate(d);t.After(latest){latest=t}} }
+ s,e:=textFile(root,".fireweed/drills/"+module+".md");if e!=nil{return false};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(s);if e!=nil{return false};if frontString(d.Frontmatter["result"])!="pass" {return false};t,e:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,frontString(d.Frontmatter["date"]));return e==nil&&t.After(latest)
+}
+func assignIDs(root string, ch project.Change, s string) (string, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Added"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return s, nil
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	prefix := ""
+	used := map[int]bool{}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		prefix = m.IDPrefix
+		for _, it := range mustItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")) {
+			var n int
+			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(it.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
+				used[n] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	for _, other := range q {
+		for _, it := range other.Added {
+			var n int
+			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(it.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
+				used[n] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(it.ID, "new:") {
+			continue
+		}
+		n := 1
+		for used[n] {
+			n++
+		}
+		used[n] = true
+		s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, it.ID, fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", prefix, n))
+	}
+	return s, nil
+}
+func section(body, name string) string    { s, _ := contracts.Section(body, name); return s }
+func mustItems(s string) []contracts.Item { it, _ := contracts.ParseItems(s); return it }
+func deleteDisposable(root string, ch project.Change, snap project.Snapshot) error {
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		return filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+			if e != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			if d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), p)
+			if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones) == "disposable" {
+				return os.Remove(p)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func restoreAttempt(root string, ch project.Change, n int, approved string) error {
+	ref := "refs/fireweed/attempts/" + ch.Slug + "/" + strconv.Itoa(n)
+	files, e := git(root, "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD", ref)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, path := range strings.Split(files, "\n") {
+		if path == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if path == ch.Path {
+			old, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, ref, path)
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(old))
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			cur, _ := contracts.ParseDocument(approved)
+			if s, ok := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Audit"); ok {
+				cur.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(cur.Body, "Audit", s)
+			}
+			text, e := render(cur)
+			if e == nil {
+				_ = writeFile(root, path, text)
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, ref, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, path))
+			continue
+		}
+		_ = writeFile(root, path, string(b))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func sortedKeys(m map[string]any) []string {
+	k := make([]string, 0, len(m))
+	for a := range m {
+		k = append(k, a)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(k)
+	return k
+}
+
+var _ = errors.New
+var _ = context.Background
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..61a525268577e7ffe33c8e223645ad63dcf2d230
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
@@ -0,0 +1,296 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	req.Quick = false
+	out, e := verify(ctx, req)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	before, e := textFile(root, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(before)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	next := ""
+	blocked := false
+	switch c.Phase {
+	case "evals":
+		next = "audit"
+		audit := nested(c.Snapshot.Config, "audit")
+		if enabled, ok := audit["enabled"].(bool); ok && !enabled {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+	case "audit":
+		body, untestable, ae := auditSubmission(ch, c)
+		if ae != nil {
+			return out, ae
+		}
+		doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Audit", body)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(body, "-") {
+			rounds := frontInt(doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])
+			max := 2
+			if n := frontInt(nested(c.Snapshot.Config, "audit")["max_rounds"]); n > 0 {
+				max = n
+			}
+			if untestable || rounds >= max {
+				blocked = true
+				next = c.Phase
+				doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = "audit findings"
+				doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Questions", body)
+			} else {
+				next = "evals"
+				doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = rounds + 1
+			}
+		} else {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+	case "impl":
+		next = "applied"
+	default:
+		return out, code("P01", "unsupported phase %s", c.Phase)
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = next
+	line := provenance(c, req, out.Reports)
+	previous := section(doc.Body, "Provenance")
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Provenance", strings.TrimSpace(previous+"\n"+line)+"\n")
+	text, e := render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(root, ch.Path, text); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	var specPath, specBefore string
+	if next == "applied" {
+		for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if m.Name == ch.Module {
+				specPath = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, "SPEC.md"))
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if specPath == "" {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, code("C01", "module %s missing", ch.Module)
+		}
+		specBefore, e = textFile(root, specPath)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, e
+		}
+		newSpec, ae := applySpec(specBefore, ch)
+		if ae != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, ae
+		}
+		if e = writeFile(root, specPath, newSpec); e != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, e
+		}
+		archived := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive"), 0755); e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		if e = os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, ch.Path), filepath.Join(root, archived)); e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+			if !d.Warning {
+				_ = os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, archived), filepath.Join(root, ch.Path))
+				_ = writeFile(root, specPath, specBefore)
+				_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+				return out, code(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "commit", "-m", fmt.Sprintf("fireweed %s %s", ch.Slug, c.Phase)); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	c.Phase = next
+	c.PhaseBase = head
+	c.Approved = text
+	if next == "applied" || blocked {
+		_ = releaseClaim(root, ch, oid)
+		out.State.ClaimOID = ""
+		if next == "applied" {
+			ch.Path = "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+		}
+	} else {
+		oid, e = saveClaim(root, ch, c, oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		out.State.ClaimOID = oid
+	}
+	out.State.Change = ch
+	out.State.Change.Document = doc
+	out.State.Phase = next
+	out.State.PhaseBase = head
+	out.State.Head = head
+	if blocked {
+		return out, code("P06", "change blocked")
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+func applySpec(source string, ch project.Change) (string, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(source)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Specs"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	byID := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	order := []string{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+		order = append(order, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range ch.Removed {
+		delete(byID, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range append(ch.Modified, ch.Added...) {
+		if _, ok := byID[it.ID]; !ok {
+			order = append(order, it.ID)
+		}
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+	}
+	sort.Strings(order)
+	unique := map[string]bool{}
+	lines := []string{}
+	for _, id := range order {
+		if unique[id] {
+			continue
+		}
+		unique[id] = true
+		if it, ok := byID[id]; ok {
+			lines = append(lines, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", strings.Join(lines, "\n\n")+"\n")
+	if set := nested(ch.Document.Frontmatter, "set"); len(set) > 0 {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	decisions := strings.TrimSpace(section(doc.Body, "Decisions"))
+	removed := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Removed decisions"))
+	if removed != "" {
+		for _, entry := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
+			if entry != "" {
+				decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, entry, "")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	added := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Decisions"))
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, entry := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
+			if entry != "" {
+				if decisions != "" {
+					decisions += "\n"
+				}
+				decisions += "- " + ch.Slug + ": " + entry
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n")
+	return render(doc)
+}
+
+func Context(root, selector string, full bool) (string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	ch, c, _, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	change, e := textFile(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString("# Change\n" + change + "\n# Projected spec\n")
+	for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		v, _ := render(m.Document)
+		b.WriteString(v + "\n")
+		for _, pattern := range m.Zones.Interface {
+			_ = pattern
+		}
+		_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r, m.Dir), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(r, p)
+			name := filepath.ToSlash(rel)
+			sub := strings.TrimPrefix(name, m.Dir+"/")
+			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(sub, m.Zones)
+			if zone == "interface" {
+				v, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
+				b.WriteString("\n## " + name + "\n" + string(v))
+				return nil
+			}
+			if sub == "SPEC.md" {
+				return nil
+			}
+			info, _ := d.Info()
+			if info == nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n%s %d bytes\n", name, info.Size()))
+			if full {
+				v, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
+				b.Write(v)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	system, _ := textFile(r, "SYSTEM.md")
+	b.WriteString("\n# SYSTEM\n" + system)
+	bookName := c.Phase
+	if c.Phase == "impl" && frontBool(ch.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+		bookName = "regenerate"
+	}
+	book, _ := assets.Playbook(bookName)
+	b.WriteString("\n" + book)
+	return b.String(), nil
+}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+ "context"
+ "encoding/json"
+ "os"
+ "path/filepath"
+ "sort"
+ "strconv"
+ "strings"
+ "time"
+
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+ "github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func phaseAt(root,rev,name string)string{for _,path:=range []string{"changes/"+name,"changes/archive/"+name}{b,e:=gitstore.ReadAt(root,rev,path);if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(string(b));if e==nil{return frontString(d.Frontmatter["phase"])}};return ""}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type claim struct {
+	Worktree  string           `json:"worktree"`
+	Change    string           `json:"change"`
+	Run       string           `json:"run"`
+	Phase     string           `json:"phase"`
+	PhaseBase string           `json:"phase_base"`
+	Approved  string           `json:"approved"`
+	Snapshot  project.Snapshot `json:"snapshot"`
+}
+
+func code(c string, f string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf(c+": "+f, args...) }
+func canonical(root string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := gitstore.Inspect(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return filepath.EvalSymlinks(r.Root)
+}
+func git(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+	c.Dir = root
+	c.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@local.invalid", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@local.invalid")
+	b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %s: %w", strings.Join(args, " "), strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), e)
+	}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
+}
+func runID() string {
+	b := make([]byte, 12)
+	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
+	return time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405") + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
+}
+func ref(ch project.Change) string { return "refs/fireweed/claims/" + ch.Slug }
+func readClaim(root string, ch project.Change) (claim, string, bool, error) {
+	oid, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(root, ref(ch))
+	if e != nil || !ok {
+		return claim{}, "", ok, e
+	}
+	b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(root, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return claim{}, "", true, e
+	}
+	var c claim
+	e = json.Unmarshal(b, &c)
+	return c, oid, true, e
+}
+func saveClaim(root string, ch project.Change, c claim, old string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := json.Marshal(c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	oid, e := gitstore.WriteBlob(root, b)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, ref(ch), old, oid); e != nil {
+		return "", code("P02", "claim already held: %v", e)
+	}
+	return oid, nil
+}
+func releaseClaim(root string, ch project.Change, oid string) error {
+	return gitstore.CASRef(root, ref(ch), oid, "")
+}
+func dirty(root string) (bool, error) {
+	s, e := git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
+	return s != "", e
+}
+func textFile(root, path string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path)))
+	return string(b), e
+}
+func writeFile(root, path, value string) error {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(p, []byte(value), 0644)
+}
+func frontString(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+func frontInt(v any) int {
+	switch n := v.(type) {
+	case int:
+		return n
+	case float64:
+		return int(n)
+	case string:
+		i, _ := strconv.Atoi(n)
+		return i
+	}
+	return 0
+}
+func frontBool(v any) bool { b, _ := v.(bool); return b }
+func list(v any) []string {
+	out := []string{}
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case []any:
+		for _, a := range x {
+			out = append(out, fmt.Sprint(a))
+		}
+	case []string:
+		return x
+	case string:
+		if x != "" {
+			out = append(out, x)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func nested(m map[string]any, k string) map[string]any { v, _ := m[k].(map[string]any); return v }
+func render(doc contracts.Document) (string, error)    { return contracts.RenderDocument(doc) }
+func updateDoc(root, path string, mutate func(*contracts.Document) error) error {
+	s, e := textFile(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = mutate(&d); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	s, e = render(d)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return writeFile(root, path, s)
+}
+func archiveQueue(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	q, e := project.Queue(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	entries, e := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive"))
+	if e != nil && !os.IsNotExist(e) {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	for _, ent := range entries {
+		if ent.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(ent.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		path := "changes/archive/" + ent.Name()
+		s, e := textFile(root, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		q = append(q, project.Change{Path: path, Slug: slug(ent.Name()), Module: frontString(d.Frontmatter["module"]), Document: d})
+	}
+	return q, nil
+}
+func slug(name string) string {
+	name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(name), ".md")
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(name, '-'); i >= 0 && i+1 < len(name) {
+		return name[i+1:]
+	}
+	return name
+}
+func selectChange(root, selector string, archive bool) (project.Change, error) {
+	var all []project.Change
+	var e error
+	if archive {
+		all, e = archiveQueue(root)
+	} else {
+		all, e = project.Queue(root)
+	}
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	valid := []string{}
+	matches := []project.Change{}
+	for _, ch := range all {
+		valid = append(valid, ch.Slug)
+		if selector == ch.Slug || selector == ch.Path || selector == filepath.Base(ch.Path) {
+			matches = append(matches, ch)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(matches) != 1 {
+		return project.Change{}, code("U02", "change %q not found or ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", "))
+	}
+	return matches[0], nil
+}
+func state(root string, ch project.Change, c claim, oid string) (model.State, error) {
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	for _, v := range q {
+		if v.Path == ch.Path {
+			ch = v
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return model.State{Change: ch, Snapshot: c.Snapshot, Run: c.Run, Phase: c.Phase, Head: head, PhaseBase: c.PhaseBase, ClaimOID: oid}, nil
+}
+func owned(root string, selector string) (project.Change, claim, string, error) {
+	var ch project.Change
+	var e error
+	if selector == "" {
+		q, qe := project.Queue(root)
+		if qe != nil {
+			return ch, claim{}, "", qe
+		}
+		for _, candidate := range q {
+			c, oid, ok, re := readClaim(root, candidate)
+			if re != nil {
+				return ch, claim{}, "", re
+			}
+			if ok && c.Worktree == root {
+				return candidate, c, oid, nil
+			}
+		}
+		return ch, claim{}, "", code("P02", "worktree holds no change")
+	}
+	ch, e = selectChange(root, selector, false)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ch, claim{}, "", e
+	}
+	c, oid, ok, e := readClaim(root, ch)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ch, c, oid, e
+	}
+	if !ok {
+		return ch, c, oid, code("P02", "change has no claim")
+	}
+	if c.Worktree != root {
+		return ch, c, oid, code("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
+	}
+	return ch, c, oid, nil
+}
+func Current(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return state(r, ch, c, oid)
+}
+func Release(root, selector string) error {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	ch, _, oid, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+}
+func depends(mods []project.Module, from, to string) bool {
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	var walk func(string) bool
+	walk = func(n string) bool {
+		if seen[n] {
+			return false
+		}
+		seen[n] = true
+		for _, m := range mods {
+			if m.Name == n {
+				for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+					if d == to || walk(d) {
+						return true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		return false
+	}
+	return walk(from)
+}
+func waiting(root string, q []project.Change, i int) (string, string) {
+	candidate := q[i]
+	if frontString(candidate.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(root, candidate.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
+		block := q[j]
+		if frontString(block.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if candidate.Module == block.Module {
+			return block.Slug, "same_module"
+		}
+		if depends(snap.Modules, candidate.Module, block.Module) {
+			return block.Slug, "depends_on_blocked"
+		}
+		iface, _ := contracts.Section(candidate.Document.Body, "Interface")
+		if strings.TrimSpace(iface) != "" && depends(snap.Modules, block.Module, candidate.Module) {
+			return block.Slug, "interface_dependency"
+		}
+	}
+	return "", ""
+}
+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []project.Change{}
+	for i, ch := range q {
+		if frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		on, _ := waiting(r, q, i)
+		if on == "" {
+			out = append(out, ch)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func start(root, selector string, attempt int, resume bool) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	var ch project.Change
+	if selector != "" {
+		ch, e = selectChange(r, selector, false)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	if resume {
+		if attempt <= 0 {
+			return model.State{}, code("P01", "invalid attempt %d", attempt)
+		}

+		}
+		if !ok {

+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
