@@ -0,0 +1,285 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func phaseAt(root, rev, name string) string {
+	for _, path := range []string{"changes/" + name, "changes/archive/" + name} {
+		b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, rev, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+		if e == nil {
+			return frontString(d.Frontmatter["phase"])
+		}
+	}
+	return ""
+}
+func Commits(root, selector string) ([]string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	ch, e := selectChange(r, selector, true)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	output, e := git(r, "rev-list", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []string{}
+	name := filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+	for _, oid := range strings.Fields(output) {
+		parent, _ := git(r, "rev-parse", oid+"^1")
+		if parent == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		a, b := phaseAt(r, oid, name), phaseAt(r, parent, name)
+		if a != "" && a != b {
+			out = append(out, oid)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func Abandon(root, selector string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	ch, e := selectChange(r, selector, true)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	isDirty, e := dirty(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if isDirty {
+		return "", code("P01", "abandon requires clean worktree")
+	}
+	if strings.Contains(ch.Path, "/archive/") {
+		return "", code("P01", "applied archived change cannot be abandoned")
+	}
+	_, oid, ok, e := readClaim(r, ch)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if ok {
+		c, _, _, _ := readClaim(r, ch)
+		if c.Worktree != r {
+			return "", code("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
+		}
+	}
+	commits, e := Commits(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	for _, commit := range commits {
+		paths, _ := git(r, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", commit)
+		for _, path := range strings.Split(paths, "\n") {
+			if path == "" || path == ch.Path || strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") {
+				continue
+			}
+			if _, readErr := gitstore.ReadAt(r, commit+"^1", path); readErr != nil {
+				_, _ = git(r, "rm", "-f", "--", path)
+			} else {
+				_, _ = git(r, "restore", "--source="+commit+"^1", "--staged", "--worktree", "--", path)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(r, ch.Path)); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "commit", "-m", "fireweed abandon "+ch.Slug); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if ok {
+		_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+	}
+	return git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+}
+func Block(req model.BlockRequest) (model.BlockResult, error) {
+	var out model.BlockResult
+	r, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(r, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	head, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if head != c.PhaseBase {
+		return out, code("P05", "phase base changed")
+	}
+	if e = approvedCheck(r, ch, c); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	n := 1
+	for {
+		_, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(r, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"+ch.Slug+"/"+strconv.Itoa(n))
+		if e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		if !ok {
+			break
+		}
+		n++
+	}
+	name := "refs/fireweed/attempts/" + ch.Slug + "/" + strconv.Itoa(n)
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	tree, e := git(r, "write-tree")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	attempt, e := git(r, "commit-tree", tree, "-p", head, "-m", "fireweed attempt "+ch.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(r, name, "", attempt); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.AttemptRef = name
+	out.AttemptOID = attempt
+	if _, e = git(r, "reset", "--hard", head); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	_, _ = git(r, "clean", "-fd")
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(c.Approved)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = req.Reason
+	s, e := render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(r, ch.Path, s); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "--", ch.Path); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "commit", "-m", "fireweed block "+ch.Slug); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+	head, e = git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	c.PhaseBase = head
+	out.State, e = state(r, ch, c, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.State.Change.Document = doc
+	return out, nil
+}
+func GC(ctx context.Context, req model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult, error) {
+	_ = ctx
+	out := model.GCResult{Pruned: []string{}}
+	r, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	max := 720 * time.Hour
+	if raw := frontString(nested(snap.Config, "gc")["drill_max_age"]); raw != "" {
+		max, e = time.ParseDuration(raw)
+		if e != nil || max <= 0 {
+			return out, code("C01", "invalid gc.drill_max_age %q", raw)
+		}
+	}
+	now := req.Now
+	if now.IsZero() {
+		now = time.Now().UTC()
+	}
+	refs, e := git(r, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)", "refs/fireweed")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	registered, _ := git(r, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
+	worktrees := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(registered, "\n") {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "worktree ") {
+			p, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "worktree "))
+			worktrees[p] = true
+		}
+	}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(refs, "\n") {
+		parts := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(parts) != 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		name, oid := parts[0], parts[1]
+		remove := false
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/claims/") {
+			b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(r, oid)
+			if e == nil {
+				var c claim
+				if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) == nil {
+					p, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(c.Worktree)
+					remove = !worktrees[p]
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/attempts/") {
+			bits := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"), "/")
+			if len(bits) == 2 {
+				n, e := strconv.Atoi(bits[1])
+				if e == nil && n > 0 {
+					entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(r, "changes", "archive"))
+					for _, ent := range entries {
+						if slug(ent.Name()) == bits[0] {
+							remove = true
+							break
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/drills/") {
+			bits := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/drills/"), "/")
+			if len(bits) == 2 {
+				date, e := time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000", bits[1])
+				if e == nil && date.Before(now.Add(-max)) {
+					remove = true
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if remove {
+			if gitstore.CASRef(r, name, oid, "") == nil {
+				out.Pruned = append(out.Pruned, name)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(out.Pruned)
+	return out, nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/reports.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/reports.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..30dd968a16b53a9f4288eb772d682e8012821aac
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/reports.go
@@ -0,0 +1,384 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func exceptions(mods []project.Module) ([]model.Quarantine, []model.BoundaryOptOut) {
+	q := []model.Quarantine{}
+	b := []model.BoundaryOptOut{}
+	for _, m := range mods {
+		if reason := frontString(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]); reason != "" {
+			b = append(b, model.BoundaryOptOut{Module: m.Name, Reason: reason})
+		}
+		for _, it := range mustItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")) {
+			if i := strings.Index(it.Tag, "quarantine:"); i >= 0 {
+				q = append(q, model.Quarantine{Module: m.Name, ID: it.ID, Reason: strings.TrimSpace(it.Tag[i+len("quarantine:"):])})
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return q, b
+}
+func implDate(doc contracts.Document) time.Time {
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(section(doc.Body, "Provenance"), "\n") {
+		f := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(f) >= 3 && f[0] == "-" && f[1] == "impl" {
+			if t, e := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, f[2]); e == nil {
+				return t
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return time.Time{}
+}
+func Status(root string) (model.StatusReport, error) {
+	out := model.StatusReport{DriftSinceDrill: map[string]int{}, PhaseCommits: map[string]int{}}
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.Modules = snap.Modules
+	out.Quarantines, out.BoundaryOptOuts = exceptions(snap.Modules)
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	for i, ch := range q {
+		phase := frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["phase"])
+		if phase == "" {
+			phase = "queued"
+		}
+		blocked := frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"])
+		on, rule := waiting(r, q, i)
+		out.Queue = append(out.Queue, model.StatusEntry{Slug: ch.Slug, Path: ch.Path, Module: ch.Module, Phase: phase, Blocked: blocked, AuditRounds: frontInt(ch.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]), WaitingOn: on, WaitingRule: rule})
+	}
+	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(r, "changes", "archive"))
+	type applied struct {
+		module, path string
+		date         time.Time
+	}
+	appliedList := []applied{}
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		name := entry.Name()
+		path := "changes/archive/" + name
+		s, e := textFile(r, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil || frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]) != "applied" {
+			continue
+		}
+		module := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["module"])
+		appliedList = append(appliedList, applied{module, path, implDate(doc)})
+		commits, _ := Commits(r, path)
+		out.PhaseCommits[strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".md")] = len(commits)
+	}
+	sort.Slice(appliedList, func(i, j int) bool {
+		if appliedList[i].date.Equal(appliedList[j].date) {
+			return appliedList[i].path < appliedList[j].path
+		}
+		return appliedList[i].date.After(appliedList[j].date)
+	})
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		drill := time.Time{}
+		if s, e := textFile(r, ".fireweed/drills/"+m.Name+".md"); e == nil {
+			if d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s); e == nil {
+				drill, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, frontString(d.Frontmatter["date"]))
+			}
+		}
+		for _, a := range appliedList {
+			if a.module == m.Name && (drill.IsZero() || a.date.After(drill)) {
+				out.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if len(appliedList) >= 3 {
+		first := appliedList[0].module
+		n := 0
+		for _, a := range appliedList {
+			if a.module != first {
+				break
+			}
+			n++
+		}
+		if n >= 3 {
+			out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P08", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes", first, n), Warning: true})
+		}
+	}
+	remote := frontString(snap.Config["remote"])
+	if remote == "" {
+		remote = "origin"
+	}
+	base := frontString(snap.Config["base"])
+	ref, _ := gitstore.BaseRef(r, remote, base)
+	for _, a := range appliedList {
+		if ref == "" {
+			out.Unapproved++
+			continue
+		}
+		name := filepath.Base(a.path)
+		_, archiveErr := gitstore.ReadAt(r, ref, a.path)
+		_, pendingErr := gitstore.ReadAt(r, ref, "changes/"+name)
+		if archiveErr != nil && pendingErr != nil {
+			out.Unapproved++
+		}
+	}
+	snapshots, _ := Costs(r)
+	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
+	warnings := map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, s := range snapshots {
+		for _, cost := range s.Modules {
+			latest[cost.Module] = cost
+			warnings[cost.Module] = s.Diagnostics
+		}
+	}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if cost, ok := latest[m.Name]; ok {
+			out.Costs = append(out.Costs, cost)
+			for _, d := range warnings[m.Name] {
+				found := false
+				for _, old := range out.Diagnostics {
+					if old == d {
+						found = true
+					}
+				}
+				if !found {
+					out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, d)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+type endpointError struct{ cause error }
+
+func (e endpointError) Error() string      { return e.cause.Error() }
+func (e endpointError) Unwrap() error      { return e.cause }
+func IsEndpointConfigError(err error) bool { var e endpointError; return errors.As(err, &e) }
+func PRBody(root, revisionRange string) (model.PRBodyReport, error) {
+	out := model.PRBodyReport{}
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	parts := strings.Split(revisionRange, "..")
+	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" {
+		return out, code("P01", "invalid range %q", revisionRange)
+	}
+	start, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[0]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, code("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	end, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[1]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, code("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	snap, e := project.LoadAt(r, end)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, endpointError{e}
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("# Changes %s..%s\n\n", start, end))
+	diff, e := git(r, "diff", "--name-status", start, end)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	touched := map[string]bool{}
+	changedFiles := []string{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(diff, "\n") {
+		f := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(f) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		path := f[len(f)-1]
+		changedFiles = append(changedFiles, path)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/") {
+			touched[filepath.Base(path)] = true
+		}
+	}
+	tree, e := git(r, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", end, "changes")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	selected := []string{}
+	for _, path := range strings.Split(tree, "\n") {
+		if !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".md") || !touched[filepath.Base(path)] {
+			continue
+		}
+		selected = append(selected, path)
+	}
+	if len(selected) == 0 {
+		b.WriteString("No selected changes.\n")
+	}
+	for _, path := range selected {
+		raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, end, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		module := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["module"])
+		kind := "spec"
+		if len(list(doc.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+			kind = "eval_fix"
+		} else if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+			kind = "regenerate"
+		} else if len(mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Added")))+len(mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Modified"))) == 0 {
+			kind = "maintenance"
+		}
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n## %s\n\nModule: %s; kind: %s; audit_rounds: %d\n", path, module, kind, frontInt(doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])))
+		b.WriteString("\n" + section(doc.Body, "Provenance") + "\n" + section(doc.Body, "Decisions") + "\n" + section(doc.Body, "Removed decisions") + "\n")
+		for _, it := range append(mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Added")), mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Modified"))...) {
+			if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "review") {
+				b.WriteString("\n" + it.ID + " " + strings.TrimSpace(it.Body) + "\n")
+			}
+		}
+		// Earlier phase documents remain useful even when the selected range contains only implementation.
+		commits, _ := git(r, "rev-list", end)
+		historicalFiles := map[string]bool{}
+		for _, oid := range strings.Fields(commits) {
+			parent, _ := git(r,"rev-parse",oid+"^1")
+			if parent!="" && phaseAt(r,oid,filepath.Base(path))!=phaseAt(r,parent,filepath.Base(path)) {
+				paths,_:=git(r,"diff-tree","--no-commit-id","--name-only","-r",oid)
+				for _,name:=range strings.Split(paths,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(name,"packages/"+module+"/")||name=="workspace.lock"{historicalFiles[name]=true}}
+			}
+			for _, p := range []string{"changes/" + filepath.Base(path), "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(path)} {
+				raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, oid, p)
+				if e != nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+				if e == nil {
+					audit := section(d.Body, "Audit")
+					if strings.Contains(audit, "finding") || strings.Contains(audit, "FINDING") {
+						b.WriteString("\n" + audit + "\n")
+					}
+				}
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		for _, file := range changedFiles {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(file, "packages/"+module+"/") || strings.HasSuffix(file, "workspace.lock") {
+				historicalFiles[file]=true
+			}
+		}
+		paths:=make([]string,0,len(historicalFiles));for name:=range historicalFiles{paths=append(paths,name)};sort.Strings(paths);for _,name:=range paths{b.WriteString("\n- "+name)}
+		b.WriteString("\n")
+	}
+	q, opts := exceptions(snap.Modules)
+	for _, v := range q {
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\nQuarantine: %s %s %s\n", v.Module, v.ID, v.Reason))
+	}
+	for _, v := range opts {
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\nBoundary opt-out: %s %s\n", v.Module, v.Reason))
+	}
+	for _, path := range strings.Split(tree, "\n") {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/") || strings.Contains(path, "/archive/") {
+			continue
+		}
+		raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, end, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if e == nil {
+			if reason := frontString(d.Frontmatter["blocked"]); reason != "" {
+				b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\nBlocked %s: %s\n", path, reason))
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	snapshots, _ := Costs(r)
+	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
+	ds := map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, s := range snapshots {
+		for _, c := range s.Modules {
+			latest[c.Module] = c
+			ds[c.Module] = s.Diagnostics
+		}
+	}
+	b.WriteString("\n## Costs\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n|---|---:|---|---:|---:|\n")
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		c, ok := latest[m.Name]
+		if !ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		ids := []string{}
+		for id := range c.CasesPerSpec {
+			ids = append(ids, id)
+		}
+		sort.Strings(ids)
+		cases := []string{}
+		for _, id := range ids {
+			cases = append(cases, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d", id, c.CasesPerSpec[id]))
+		}
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n", m.Name, c.Seconds, strings.Join(cases, ", "), c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines))
+		for _, d := range ds[m.Name] {
+			found := false
+			for _, old := range out.Diagnostics {
+				if old == d {
+					found = true
+				}
+			}
+			if !found {
+				out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, d)
+				b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n%s: %s\n", d.Code, d.Message))
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, path := range changedFiles {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "packages/") {
+			continue
+		}
+		var mod project.Module
+		ok := false
+		for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(path, m.Dir+"/") {
+				mod = m
+				ok = true
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if !ok || contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(path, mod.Dir+"/"), mod.Zones) != "disposable" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, start, path); e == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		data, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, end, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if len(data) <= 262144 && !strings.ContainsRune(string(data), 0) {
+			continue
+		}

+}

+}
+func saveReport(root string,c claim,name string,r checks.Report)error{dir:=filepath.Join(root,".fireweed","runs",c.Run,c.Phase);if e:=os.MkdirAll(dir,0755);e!=nil{return e};b,_:=json.MarshalIndent(r,"","  ");return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,name+".json"),b,0644)}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type claim struct {
+	Worktree  string           `json:"worktree"`
+	Change    string           `json:"change"`
+	Run       string           `json:"run"`
+	Phase     string           `json:"phase"`
+	PhaseBase string           `json:"phase_base"`
+	Approved  string           `json:"approved"`
+	Snapshot  project.Snapshot `json:"snapshot"`
+}
+
+func code(c string, f string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf(c+": "+f, args...) }
+func canonical(root string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := gitstore.Inspect(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return filepath.EvalSymlinks(r.Root)
+}
+func git(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+	c.Dir = root
+	c.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@local.invalid", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@local.invalid")
+	b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %s: %w", strings.Join(args, " "), strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), e)
+	}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
+}
+func runID() string {
+	b := make([]byte, 12)
+	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
+	return time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405") + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
+}
+func ref(ch project.Change) string { return "refs/fireweed/claims/" + ch.Slug }
+func readClaim(root string, ch project.Change) (claim, string, bool, error) {
+	oid, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(root, ref(ch))
+	if e != nil || !ok {
+		return claim{}, "", ok, e
+	}
+	b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(root, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return claim{}, "", true, e
+	}
+	var c claim
+	e = json.Unmarshal(b, &c)
+	return c, oid, true, e
+}
+func saveClaim(root string, ch project.Change, c claim, old string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := json.Marshal(c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	oid, e := gitstore.WriteBlob(root, b)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, ref(ch), old, oid); e != nil {
+		return "", code("P02", "claim already held: %v", e)
+	}
+	return oid, nil
+}
+func releaseClaim(root string, ch project.Change, oid string) error {
+	return gitstore.CASRef(root, ref(ch), oid, "")
+}
+func dirty(root string) (bool, error) {
+	s, e := git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
+	return s != "", e
+}
+func textFile(root, path string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path)))
+	return string(b), e
+}
+func writeFile(root, path, value string) error {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(p, []byte(value), 0644)
+}
+func frontString(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+func frontInt(v any) int {
+	switch n := v.(type) {
+	case int:
+		return n
+	case float64:
+		return int(n)
+	case string:
+		i, _ := strconv.Atoi(n)
+		return i
+	}
+	return 0
+}
+func frontBool(v any) bool { b, _ := v.(bool); return b }
+func frontTime(v any) time.Time { if t,ok:=v.(time.Time);ok{return t}; t,_:=time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano,frontString(v)); return t }
+func list(v any) []string {
+	out := []string{}
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case []any:
+		for _, a := range x {
+			out = append(out, fmt.Sprint(a))
+		}
+	case []string:
+		return x
+	case string:
+		if x != "" {
+			out = append(out, x)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func nested(m map[string]any, k string) map[string]any { v, _ := m[k].(map[string]any); return v }
+func render(doc contracts.Document) (string, error)    { return contracts.RenderDocument(doc) }
+func updateDoc(root, path string, mutate func(*contracts.Document) error) error {
+	s, e := textFile(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = mutate(&d); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	s, e = render(d)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return writeFile(root, path, s)
+}
+func archiveQueue(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	q, e := project.Queue(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	entries, e := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive"))
+	if e != nil && !os.IsNotExist(e) {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	for _, ent := range entries {
+		if ent.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(ent.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		path := "changes/archive/" + ent.Name()
+		s, e := textFile(root, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		q = append(q, project.Change{Path: path, Slug: slug(ent.Name()), Module: frontString(d.Frontmatter["module"]), Document: d})
+	}
+	return q, nil
+}
+func slug(name string) string {
+	name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(name), ".md")
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(name, '-'); i >= 0 && i+1 < len(name) {
+		return name[i+1:]
+	}
+	return name
+}
+func selectChange(root, selector string, archive bool) (project.Change, error) {
+	var all []project.Change
+	var e error
+	if archive {
+		all, e = archiveQueue(root)
+	} else {
+		all, e = project.Queue(root)
+	}
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	valid := []string{}
+	matches := []project.Change{}
+	for _, ch := range all {
+		valid = append(valid, ch.Slug)
+		if selector == ch.Slug || selector == ch.Path || selector == filepath.Base(ch.Path) {
+			matches = append(matches, ch)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(matches) != 1 {
+		return project.Change{}, code("U02", "change %q not found or ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", "))
+	}
+	return matches[0], nil
+}
+func state(root string, ch project.Change, c claim, oid string) (model.State, error) {
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	for _, v := range q {
+		if v.Path == ch.Path {
+			ch = v
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return model.State{Change: ch, Snapshot: c.Snapshot, Run: c.Run, Phase: c.Phase, Head: head, PhaseBase: c.PhaseBase, ClaimOID: oid}, nil
+}
+func owned(root string, selector string) (project.Change, claim, string, error) {
+	var ch project.Change
+	var e error
+	if selector == "" {
+		q, qe := project.Queue(root)
+		if qe != nil {
+			return ch, claim{}, "", qe
+		}
+		for _, candidate := range q {
+			c, oid, ok, re := readClaim(root, candidate)
+			if re != nil {
+				return ch, claim{}, "", re
+			}
+			if ok && c.Worktree == root {
+				return candidate, c, oid, nil
+			}
+		}
+		return ch, claim{}, "", code("P02", "worktree holds no change")
+	}
+	ch, e = selectChange(root, selector, false)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ch, claim{}, "", e
+	}
+	c, oid, ok, e := readClaim(root, ch)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ch, c, oid, e
+	}
+	if !ok {
+		return ch, c, oid, code("P02", "change has no claim")
+	}
+	if c.Worktree != root {
+		return ch, c, oid, code("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
+	}
+	return ch, c, oid, nil
+}
+func Current(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return state(r, ch, c, oid)
+}
+func Release(root, selector string) error {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	ch, _, oid, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+}
+func depends(mods []project.Module, from, to string) bool {
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	var walk func(string) bool
+	walk = func(n string) bool {
+		if seen[n] {
+			return false
+		}
+		seen[n] = true
+		for _, m := range mods {
+			if m.Name == n {
+				for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+					if d == to || walk(d) {
+						return true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		return false
+	}
+	return walk(from)
+}
+func waiting(root string, q []project.Change, i int) (string, string) {
+	candidate := q[i]
+	if frontString(candidate.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(root, candidate.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
+		block := q[j]
+		if frontString(block.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if candidate.Module == block.Module {
+			return block.Slug, "same_module"
+		}
+		if depends(snap.Modules, candidate.Module, block.Module) {
+			return block.Slug, "depends_on_blocked"
+		}
+		iface, _ := contracts.Section(candidate.Document.Body, "Interface")
+		if strings.TrimSpace(iface) != "" && depends(snap.Modules, block.Module, candidate.Module) {
+			return block.Slug, "interface_dependency"
+		}
+	}
+	return "", ""
+}
+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []project.Change{}
+	for i, ch := range q {
+		if frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		on, _ := waiting(r, q, i)
+		if on == "" {
+			out = append(out, ch)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func start(root, selector string, attempt int, resume bool) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	var ch project.Change
+	if selector != "" {
+		ch, e = selectChange(r, selector, false)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	if resume {
+		if attempt <= 0 {
+			return model.State{}, code("P01", "invalid attempt %d", attempt)
+		}
+		name := "refs/fireweed/attempts/" + ch.Slug + "/" + strconv.Itoa(attempt)
+		_, ok, re := gitstore.Ref(r, name)
+		if re != nil {
+			return model.State{}, re
+		}
+		if !ok {
+			return model.State{}, code("P01", "attempt %s not found", name)
+		}
+	}
+	isDirty, e := dirty(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if isDirty {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "start requires clean worktree")
+	}
+	eligible, e := Eligible(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if len(eligible) == 0 {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "no eligible change")
+	}
+	if selector == "" {
+		ch = eligible[0]
+	} else if ch.Path != eligible[0].Path {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "change is not eligible queue head")
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		status, se := Status(r)
+		if se == nil {
+			config, _ := project.Load(r)
+			max := frontInt(nested(config.Config, "authoring")["max_unapproved"])
+			if max <= 0 { max = 5 }
+			if status.Unapproved >= max {
+				return model.State{Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{{Code: "P07", Message: fmt.Sprintf("unapproved archives %d reached limit %d", status.Unapproved, max)} }}, code("P07", "unapproved archives reached limit")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if c, _, ok, re := readClaim(r, ch); re != nil {
+		return model.State{}, re
+	} else if ok {
+		return model.State{}, code("P02", "claim already held: %s: update-ref", c.Worktree)
+	}
+	head, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	original, e := textFile(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	s := original
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if resume && frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]) == "" {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "attempt requires committed phase")
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		if e = validateBases(r, ch); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		s, e = assignIDs(r, ch, s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		doc, e = contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	phase := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"])
+	run := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["run"])
+	if phase == "" {
+		phase = "evals"
+		if len(ch.Added)+len(ch.Modified)+len(ch.Removed) == 0 && len(list(doc.Frontmatter["fixes"])) == 0 && len(list(doc.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) == 0 {
+			phase = "impl"
+		}
+		if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+			phase = "impl"
+		}
+	}
+	if run == "" {
+		run = runID()
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
+	doc.Frontmatter["run"] = run
+	s, e = render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(r, ch.Path, s); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(r, ch.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		_ = writeFile(r, ch.Path, original)
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	snap.Root = r
+	c := claim{Worktree: r, Change: ch.Slug, Run: run, Phase: phase, PhaseBase: head, Approved: s, Snapshot: snap}
+	oid, e := saveClaim(r, ch, c, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		_ = writeFile(r, ch.Path, original)
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if resume {
+		e = restoreAttempt(r, ch, attempt, s)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	} else if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+		_ = deleteDisposable(r, ch, snap)
+	}
+	st, e := state(r, ch, c, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return st, e
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		config, _ := project.Load(r)
+		remote, base := frontString(config.Config["remote"]), frontString(config.Config["base"])
+		if remote == "" { remote = "origin" }; if base == "" { base = "main" }
+		local, le := gitstore.BaseRef(r, "", base)
+		shared, se := gitstore.BaseRef(r, remote, base)
+		localHas, sharedHas := false, false
+		if le == nil { _, be := gitstore.ReadAt(r, local, ch.Path); localHas = be == nil }
+		if se == nil { _, be := gitstore.ReadAt(r, shared, ch.Path); sharedHas = be == nil }
+		if !localHas && !sharedHas { st.Diagnostics = append(st.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P04", Message: "change is not on local or shared base", Warning: true}) }
+		if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) && !newerPassingDrill(r,ch.Module) { st.Diagnostics = append(st.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P10", Message: "regenerate has no newer passing drill", Warning: true}) }
+	}
+	return st, nil
+}
+func Start(root, selector string) (model.State, error) { return start(root, selector, 0, false) }
+func StartFromAttempt(root, selector string, n int) (model.State, error) {
+	return start(root, selector, n, true)
+}
+func validateBases(root string, ch project.Change) error {
+	stale, e := project.StaleSpecs(root, ch.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		if strings.Contains(e.Error(), "stale base") { return code("P05", "%v", e) }
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, s := range stale {
+		if !s.Recovered {
+			return code("P05", "stale base for %s", s.ID)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func newerPassingDrill(root,module string)bool{
+ entries,_:=os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root,"changes","archive"));latest:=time.Time{}
+ for _,entry:=range entries { s,e:=textFile(root,"changes/archive/"+entry.Name());if e!=nil{continue};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(s);if e==nil&&frontString(d.Frontmatter["module"])==module {if t:=implDate(d);t.After(latest){latest=t}} }
+ s,e:=textFile(root,".fireweed/drills/"+module+".md");if e!=nil{return false};d,e:=contracts.ParseDocument(s);if e!=nil{return false};if frontString(d.Frontmatter["result"])!="pass" {return false};t:=frontTime(d.Frontmatter["date"]);return !t.IsZero()&&t.After(latest)
+}
+func assignIDs(root string, ch project.Change, s string) (string, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Added"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return s, nil
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	prefix := ""
+	used := map[int]bool{}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		prefix = m.IDPrefix
+		for _, it := range mustItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")) {
+			var n int
+			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(it.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
+				used[n] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	for _, other := range q {
+		for _, it := range other.Added {
+			var n int
+			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(it.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
+				used[n] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(it.ID, "new:") {
+			continue
+		}
+		n := 1
+		for used[n] {
+			n++
+		}
+		used[n] = true
+		s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, it.ID, fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", prefix, n))
+	}
+	return s, nil
+}
+func section(body, name string) string    { s, _ := contracts.Section(body, name); return s }
+func mustItems(s string) []contracts.Item { it, _ := contracts.ParseItems(s); return it }
+func deleteDisposable(root string, ch project.Change, snap project.Snapshot) error {
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		return filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+			if e != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			if d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), p)
+			if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones) == "disposable" {
+				return os.Remove(p)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func restoreAttempt(root string, ch project.Change, n int, approved string) error {
+	ref := "refs/fireweed/attempts/" + ch.Slug + "/" + strconv.Itoa(n)
+	files, e := git(root, "diff", "--name-only", ref+"^1", ref)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, path := range strings.Split(files, "\n") {
+		if path == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if path == ch.Path {
+			old, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, ref, path)
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(old))
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			cur, _ := contracts.ParseDocument(approved)
+			if s, ok := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Audit"); ok {
+				cur.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(cur.Body, "Audit", s)
+			}
+			text, e := render(cur)
+			if e == nil {
+				_ = writeFile(root, path, text)
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, ref, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, path))
+			continue
+		}
+		_ = writeFile(root, path, string(b))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func sortedKeys(m map[string]any) []string {
+	k := make([]string, 0, len(m))
+	for a := range m {
+		k = append(k, a)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(k)
+	return k
+}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"

+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	req.Quick = false
+	out, e := verify(ctx, req)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	before, e := textFile(root, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(before)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	next := ""
+	blocked := false
+	switch c.Phase {
+	case "evals":
+		next = "audit"
+		audit := nested(c.Snapshot.Config, "audit")
+		if enabled, ok := audit["enabled"].(bool); ok && !enabled {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+	case "audit":
+		body, untestable, ae := auditSubmission(ch, c)
+		if ae != nil {
+			return out, ae
+		}
+		doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Audit", body)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(body, "-") {
+			rounds := frontInt(doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])
+			max := 2
+			if n := frontInt(nested(c.Snapshot.Config, "audit")["max_rounds"]); n > 0 {
+				max = n
+			}
+			if untestable || rounds >= max {
+				blocked = true
+				next = c.Phase
+				doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = "audit findings"
+				doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Questions", body)
+			} else {
+				next = "evals"
+				doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = rounds + 1
+			}
+		} else {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+	case "impl":
+		next = "applied"
+	default:
+		return out, code("P01", "unsupported phase %s", c.Phase)
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = next
+	line := provenance(c, req, out.Reports)
+	previous := section(doc.Body, "Provenance")
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Provenance", strings.TrimSpace(previous+"\n"+line)+"\n")
+	text, e := render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(root, ch.Path, text); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	var specPath, specBefore string
+	if next == "applied" {
+		for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if m.Name == ch.Module {
+				specPath = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, "SPEC.md"))
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if specPath == "" {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, code("C01", "module %s missing", ch.Module)
+		}
+		specBefore, e = textFile(root, specPath)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, e
+		}
+		newSpec, ae := applySpec(specBefore, ch)
+		if ae != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, ae
+		}
+		if e = writeFile(root, specPath, newSpec); e != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, e
+		}
+		archived := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive"), 0755); e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		if e = os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, ch.Path), filepath.Join(root, archived)); e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+			if !d.Warning {
+				_ = os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, archived), filepath.Join(root, ch.Path))
+				_ = writeFile(root, specPath, specBefore)
+				_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+				return out, code(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "commit", "-m", fmt.Sprintf("fireweed %s %s", ch.Slug, c.Phase)); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	c.Phase = next
+	c.PhaseBase = head
+	c.Approved = text
+	if next == "applied" || blocked {
+		_ = releaseClaim(root, ch, oid)
+		out.State.ClaimOID = ""
+		if next == "applied" {
+			ch.Path = "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+		}
+	} else {
+		oid, e = saveClaim(root, ch, c, oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		out.State.ClaimOID = oid
+	}
+	out.State.Change = ch
+	out.State.Change.Document = doc
+	out.State.Phase = next
+	out.State.PhaseBase = head
+	out.State.Head = head
+	if blocked {
+		return out, code("P06", "change blocked")
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+func applySpec(source string, ch project.Change) (string, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(source)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Specs"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	byID := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	order := []string{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+		order = append(order, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range ch.Removed {
+		delete(byID, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range append(ch.Modified, ch.Added...) {
+		if _, ok := byID[it.ID]; !ok {
+			order = append(order, it.ID)
+		}
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+	}
+	sort.Strings(order)
+	unique := map[string]bool{}
+	lines := []string{}
+	for _, id := range order {
+		if unique[id] {
+			continue
+		}
+		unique[id] = true
+		if it, ok := byID[id]; ok {
+			lines = append(lines, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", strings.Join(lines, "\n\n")+"\n")
+	if set := nested(ch.Document.Frontmatter, "set"); len(set) > 0 {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	decisions := strings.TrimSpace(section(doc.Body, "Decisions"))
+	removed := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Removed decisions"))
+	if removed != "" {
+		for _, entry := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
+			if entry != "" {
+				decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, entry, "")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	added := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Decisions"))
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, entry := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
+			if entry != "" {
+				if decisions != "" {
+					decisions += "\n"
+				}
+				decisions += "- " + ch.Slug + ": " + entry
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n")
+	return render(doc)
+}
+
+func Context(root, selector string, full bool) (string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	ch, c, _, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	change, e := textFile(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString("# Change\n" + change + "\n# Projected spec\n")
+	for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		v, _ := render(m.Document)
+		b.WriteString(v + "\n")
+		for _, pattern := range m.Zones.Interface {
+			_ = pattern
+		}
+		_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r, m.Dir), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(r, p)
+			name := filepath.ToSlash(rel)
+			sub := strings.TrimPrefix(name, m.Dir+"/")
+			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(sub, m.Zones)
+			if zone == "interface" {
+				v, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
+				b.WriteString("\n## " + name + "\n" + string(v))
+				return nil
+			}
+			if sub == "SPEC.md" {
+				return nil
+			}
+			info, _ := d.Info()
+			if info == nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n%s %d bytes\n", name, info.Size()))
+			if full {
+				v, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
+				b.Write(v)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	system, _ := textFile(r, "SYSTEM.md")
+	b.WriteString("\n# SYSTEM\n" + system)
+	bookName := c.Phase
+	if c.Phase == "impl" && frontBool(ch.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+		bookName = "regenerate"
+	}
+	book, _ := assets.Playbook(bookName)
+	b.WriteString("\n" + book)
+	return b.String(), nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/history.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/history.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..220de39a53b60faa4e60cf200f4990802250745d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/history.go
@@ -0,0 +1,285 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func phaseAt(root, rev, name string) string {
+	for _, path := range []string{"changes/" + name, "changes/archive/" + name} {
+		b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, rev, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+		if e == nil {
+			return frontString(d.Frontmatter["phase"])
+		}
+	}
+	return ""
+}
+func Commits(root, selector string) ([]string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	ch, e := selectChange(r, selector, true)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	output, e := git(r, "rev-list", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []string{}
+	name := filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+	for _, oid := range strings.Fields(output) {
+		parent, _ := git(r, "rev-parse", oid+"^1")
+		if parent == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		a, b := phaseAt(r, oid, name), phaseAt(r, parent, name)
+		if a != "" && a != b {
+			out = append(out, oid)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func Abandon(root, selector string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	ch, e := selectChange(r, selector, true)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	isDirty, e := dirty(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if isDirty {
+		return "", code("P01", "abandon requires clean worktree")
+	}
+	if strings.Contains(ch.Path, "/archive/") {
+		return "", code("P01", "applied archived change cannot be abandoned")
+	}
+	_, oid, ok, e := readClaim(r, ch)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if ok {
+		c, _, _, _ := readClaim(r, ch)
+		if c.Worktree != r {
+			return "", code("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
+		}
+	}
+	commits, e := Commits(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	for _, commit := range commits {
+		paths, _ := git(r, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", commit)
+		for _, path := range strings.Split(paths, "\n") {
+			if path == "" || path == ch.Path || strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") {
+				continue
+			}
+			if _, readErr := gitstore.ReadAt(r, commit+"^1", path); readErr != nil {
+				_, _ = git(r, "rm", "-f", "--", path)
+			} else {
+				_, _ = git(r, "restore", "--source="+commit+"^1", "--staged", "--worktree", "--", path)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(r, ch.Path)); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "commit", "-m", "fireweed abandon "+ch.Slug); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if ok {
+		_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+	}
+	return git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+}
+func Block(req model.BlockRequest) (model.BlockResult, error) {
+	var out model.BlockResult
+	r, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(r, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	head, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if head != c.PhaseBase {
+		return out, code("P05", "phase base changed")
+	}
+	if e = approvedCheck(r, ch, c); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	n := 1
+	for {
+		_, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(r, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"+ch.Slug+"/"+strconv.Itoa(n))
+		if e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		if !ok {
+			break
+		}
+		n++
+	}
+	name := "refs/fireweed/attempts/" + ch.Slug + "/" + strconv.Itoa(n)
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	tree, e := git(r, "write-tree")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	attempt, e := git(r, "commit-tree", tree, "-p", head, "-m", "fireweed attempt "+ch.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(r, name, "", attempt); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.AttemptRef = name
+	out.AttemptOID = attempt
+	if _, e = git(r, "reset", "--hard", head); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	_, _ = git(r, "clean", "-fd")
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(c.Approved)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = req.Reason
+	s, e := render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(r, ch.Path, s); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "--", ch.Path); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "commit", "-m", "fireweed block "+ch.Slug); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+	head, e = git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	c.PhaseBase = head
+	out.State, e = state(r, ch, c, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.State.Change.Document = doc
+	return out, nil
+}
+func GC(ctx context.Context, req model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult, error) {
+	_ = ctx
+	out := model.GCResult{Pruned: []string{}}
+	r, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	max := 720 * time.Hour
+	if raw := frontString(nested(snap.Config, "gc")["drill_max_age"]); raw != "" {
+		max, e = time.ParseDuration(raw)
+		if e != nil || max <= 0 {
+			return out, code("C01", "invalid gc.drill_max_age %q", raw)
+		}
+	}
+	now := req.Now
+	if now.IsZero() {
+		now = time.Now().UTC()
+	}
+	refs, e := git(r, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)", "refs/fireweed")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	registered, _ := git(r, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
+	worktrees := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(registered, "\n") {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "worktree ") {
+			p, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "worktree "))
+			worktrees[p] = true
+		}
+	}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(refs, "\n") {
+		parts := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(parts) != 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		name, oid := parts[0], parts[1]
+		remove := false
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/claims/") {
+			b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(r, oid)
+			if e == nil {
+				var c claim
+				if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) == nil {
+					p, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(c.Worktree)
+					remove = !worktrees[p]
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/attempts/") {
+			bits := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"), "/")
+			if len(bits) == 2 {
+				n, e := strconv.Atoi(bits[1])
+				if e == nil && n > 0 {
+					entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(r, "changes", "archive"))
+					for _, ent := range entries {
+						if slug(ent.Name()) == bits[0] {
+							remove = true
+							break
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/drills/") {
+			bits := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/drills/"), "/")
+			if len(bits) == 2 {
+				date, e := time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000", bits[1])
+				if e == nil && date.Before(now.Add(-max)) {
+					remove = true
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if remove {
+			if gitstore.CASRef(r, name, oid, "") == nil {
+				out.Pruned = append(out.Pruned, name)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(out.Pruned)
+	return out, nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/reports.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/reports.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..be1a037fa2cfd2738f39a2e49fc84abec83c9970
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/reports.go
@@ -0,0 +1,384 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func exceptions(mods []project.Module) ([]model.Quarantine, []model.BoundaryOptOut) {
+	q := []model.Quarantine{}
+	b := []model.BoundaryOptOut{}
+	for _, m := range mods {
+		if reason := frontString(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]); reason != "" {
+			b = append(b, model.BoundaryOptOut{Module: m.Name, Reason: reason})
+		}
+		for _, it := range mustItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")) {
+			if i := strings.Index(it.Tag, "quarantine:"); i >= 0 {
+				q = append(q, model.Quarantine{Module: m.Name, ID: it.ID, Reason: strings.TrimSpace(it.Tag[i+len("quarantine:"):])})
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return q, b
+}
+func implDate(doc contracts.Document) time.Time {
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(section(doc.Body, "Provenance"), "\n") {
+		f := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(f) >= 3 && f[0] == "-" && f[1] == "impl" {
+			if t, e := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, f[2]); e == nil {
+				return t
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return time.Time{}
+}
+func Status(root string) (model.StatusReport, error) {
+	out := model.StatusReport{DriftSinceDrill: map[string]int{}, PhaseCommits: map[string]int{}}
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.Modules = snap.Modules
+	out.Quarantines, out.BoundaryOptOuts = exceptions(snap.Modules)
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	for i, ch := range q {
+		phase := frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["phase"])
+		if phase == "" {
+			phase = "queued"
+		}
+		blocked := frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"])
+		on, rule := waiting(r, q, i)
+		out.Queue = append(out.Queue, model.StatusEntry{Slug: ch.Slug, Path: ch.Path, Module: ch.Module, Phase: phase, Blocked: blocked, AuditRounds: frontInt(ch.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]), WaitingOn: on, WaitingRule: rule})
+	}
+	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(r, "changes", "archive"))
+	type applied struct {
+		module, path string
+		date         time.Time
+	}
+	appliedList := []applied{}
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		name := entry.Name()
+		path := "changes/archive/" + name
+		s, e := textFile(r, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil || frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]) != "applied" {
+			continue
+		}
+		module := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["module"])
+		appliedList = append(appliedList, applied{module, path, implDate(doc)})
+		commits, _ := Commits(r, path)
+		out.PhaseCommits[strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".md")] = len(commits)
+	}
+	sort.Slice(appliedList, func(i, j int) bool {
+		if appliedList[i].date.Equal(appliedList[j].date) {
+			return appliedList[i].path < appliedList[j].path
+		}
+		return appliedList[i].date.After(appliedList[j].date)
+	})
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		drill := time.Time{}
+		if s, e := textFile(r, ".fireweed/drills/"+m.Name+".md"); e == nil {
+			if d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s); e == nil {
+				drill = frontTime(d.Frontmatter["date"])
+			}
+		}
+		for _, a := range appliedList {
+			if a.module == m.Name && (drill.IsZero() || a.date.After(drill)) {
+				out.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if len(appliedList) >= 3 {
+		first := appliedList[0].module
+		n := 0
+		for _, a := range appliedList {
+			if a.module != first {
+				break
+			}
+			n++
+		}
+		if n >= 3 {
+			out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P08", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes", first, n), Warning: true})
+		}
+	}
+	remote := frontString(snap.Config["remote"])
+	if remote == "" {
+		remote = "origin"
+	}
+	base := frontString(snap.Config["base"])
+	ref, _ := gitstore.BaseRef(r, remote, base)
+	for _, a := range appliedList {
+		if ref == "" {
+			out.Unapproved++
+			continue
+		}
+		name := filepath.Base(a.path)
+		_, archiveErr := gitstore.ReadAt(r, ref, a.path)
+		_, pendingErr := gitstore.ReadAt(r, ref, "changes/"+name)
+		if archiveErr != nil && pendingErr != nil {
+			out.Unapproved++
+		}
+	}
+	snapshots, _ := Costs(r)
+	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
+	warnings := map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, s := range snapshots {
+		for _, cost := range s.Modules {
+			latest[cost.Module] = cost
+			warnings[cost.Module] = s.Diagnostics
+		}
+	}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if cost, ok := latest[m.Name]; ok {
+			out.Costs = append(out.Costs, cost)
+			for _, d := range warnings[m.Name] {
+				found := false
+				for _, old := range out.Diagnostics {
+					if old == d {
+						found = true
+					}
+				}
+				if !found {
+					out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, d)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+type endpointError struct{ cause error }
+
+func (e endpointError) Error() string      { return e.cause.Error() }
+func (e endpointError) Unwrap() error      { return e.cause }
+func IsEndpointConfigError(err error) bool { var e endpointError; return errors.As(err, &e) }
+func PRBody(root, revisionRange string) (model.PRBodyReport, error) {
+	out := model.PRBodyReport{}
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	parts := strings.Split(revisionRange, "..")
+	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" {
+		return out, code("P01", "invalid range %q", revisionRange)
+	}
+	start, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[0]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, code("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	end, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[1]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, code("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	snap, e := project.LoadAt(r, end)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, endpointError{e}
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("# Changes %s..%s\n\n", start, end))
+	diff, e := git(r, "diff", "--name-status", start, end)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	touched := map[string]bool{}
+	changedFiles := []string{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(diff, "\n") {
+		f := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(f) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		path := f[len(f)-1]
+		changedFiles = append(changedFiles, path)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/") {
+			touched[filepath.Base(path)] = true
+		}
+	}
+	tree, e := git(r, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", end, "changes")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	selected := []string{}
+	for _, path := range strings.Split(tree, "\n") {
+		if !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".md") || !touched[filepath.Base(path)] {
+			continue
+		}
+		selected = append(selected, path)
+	}
+	if len(selected) == 0 {
+		b.WriteString("No selected changes.\n")
+	}
+	for _, path := range selected {
+		raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, end, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		module := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["module"])
+		kind := "spec"
+		if len(list(doc.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+			kind = "eval_fix"
+		} else if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+			kind = "regenerate"
+		} else if len(mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Added")))+len(mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Modified"))) == 0 {
+			kind = "maintenance"
+		}
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n## %s\n\nModule: %s; kind: %s; audit_rounds: %d\n", path, module, kind, frontInt(doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])))
+		b.WriteString("\n" + section(doc.Body, "Provenance") + "\n" + section(doc.Body, "Decisions") + "\n" + section(doc.Body, "Removed decisions") + "\n")
+		for _, it := range append(mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Added")), mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Modified"))...) {
+			if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "review") {
+				b.WriteString("\n" + it.ID + " " + strings.TrimSpace(it.Body) + "\n")
+			}
+		}
+		// Earlier phase documents remain useful even when the selected range contains only implementation.
+		commits, _ := git(r, "rev-list", end)
+		historicalFiles := map[string]bool{}
+		for _, oid := range strings.Fields(commits) {
+			parent, _ := git(r,"rev-parse",oid+"^1")
+			if parent!="" && phaseAt(r,oid,filepath.Base(path))!=phaseAt(r,parent,filepath.Base(path)) {
+				paths,_:=git(r,"diff-tree","--no-commit-id","--name-only","-r",oid)
+				for _,name:=range strings.Split(paths,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(name,"packages/"+module+"/")||name=="workspace.lock"{historicalFiles[name]=true}}
+			}
+			for _, p := range []string{"changes/" + filepath.Base(path), "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(path)} {
+				raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, oid, p)
+				if e != nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+				if e == nil {
+					audit := section(d.Body, "Audit")
+					if strings.Contains(audit, "finding") || strings.Contains(audit, "FINDING") {
+						b.WriteString("\n" + audit + "\n")
+					}
+				}
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		for _, file := range changedFiles {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(file, "packages/"+module+"/") || strings.HasSuffix(file, "workspace.lock") {
+				historicalFiles[file]=true
+			}
+		}
+		paths:=make([]string,0,len(historicalFiles));for name:=range historicalFiles{paths=append(paths,name)};sort.Strings(paths);for _,name:=range paths{b.WriteString("\n- "+name)}
+		b.WriteString("\n")
+	}
+	q, opts := exceptions(snap.Modules)
+	for _, v := range q {
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\nQuarantine: %s %s %s\n", v.Module, v.ID, v.Reason))
+	}
+	for _, v := range opts {
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\nBoundary opt-out: %s %s\n", v.Module, v.Reason))
+	}
+	for _, path := range strings.Split(tree, "\n") {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/") || strings.Contains(path, "/archive/") {
+			continue
+		}
+		raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, end, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if e == nil {
