+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+type claim struct {
+	Worktree  string           `json:"worktree"`
+	Change    string           `json:"change"`
+	Run       string           `json:"run"`
+	Phase     string           `json:"phase"`
+	PhaseBase string           `json:"phase_base"`
+	Approved  string           `json:"approved"`
+	Snapshot  project.Snapshot `json:"snapshot"`
+}
+
+func code(c string, f string, args ...any) error { return fmt.Errorf(c+": "+f, args...) }
+func canonical(root string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := gitstore.Inspect(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	return filepath.EvalSymlinks(r.Root)
+}
+func git(root string, args ...string) (string, error) {
+	c := exec.Command("git", args...)
+	c.Dir = root
+	c.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fireweed@local.invalid", "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fireweed", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fireweed@local.invalid")
+	b, e := c.CombinedOutput()
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", fmt.Errorf("git %s: %s: %w", strings.Join(args, " "), strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), e)
+	}
+	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
+}
+func runID() string {
+	b := make([]byte, 12)
+	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
+	return time.Now().UTC().Format("20060102T150405") + "-" + hex.EncodeToString(b)
+}
+func ref(ch project.Change) string { return "refs/fireweed/claims/" + ch.Slug }
+func readClaim(root string, ch project.Change) (claim, string, bool, error) {
+	oid, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(root, ref(ch))
+	if e != nil || !ok {
+		return claim{}, "", ok, e
+	}
+	b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(root, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return claim{}, "", true, e
+	}
+	var c claim
+	e = json.Unmarshal(b, &c)
+	return c, oid, true, e
+}
+func saveClaim(root string, ch project.Change, c claim, old string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := json.Marshal(c)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	oid, e := gitstore.WriteBlob(root, b)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(root, ref(ch), old, oid); e != nil {
+		return "", code("P02", "claim already held: %v", e)
+	}
+	return oid, nil
+}
+func releaseClaim(root string, ch project.Change, oid string) error {
+	return gitstore.CASRef(root, ref(ch), oid, "")
+}
+func dirty(root string) (bool, error) {
+	s, e := git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
+	return s != "", e
+}
+func textFile(root, path string) (string, error) {
+	b, e := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path)))
+	return string(b), e
+}
+func writeFile(root, path, value string) error {
+	p := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(p, []byte(value), 0644)
+}
+func frontString(v any) string {
+	if v == nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprint(v)
+}
+func frontInt(v any) int {
+	switch n := v.(type) {
+	case int:
+		return n
+	case float64:
+		return int(n)
+	case string:
+		i, _ := strconv.Atoi(n)
+		return i
+	}
+	return 0
+}
+func frontBool(v any) bool { b, _ := v.(bool); return b }
+func frontTime(v any) time.Time {
+	if t, ok := v.(time.Time); ok {
+		return t
+	}
+	t, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, frontString(v))
+	return t
+}
+func list(v any) []string {
+	out := []string{}
+	switch x := v.(type) {
+	case []any:
+		for _, a := range x {
+			out = append(out, fmt.Sprint(a))
+		}
+	case []string:
+		return x
+	case string:
+		if x != "" {
+			out = append(out, x)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func nested(m map[string]any, k string) map[string]any { v, _ := m[k].(map[string]any); return v }
+func render(doc contracts.Document) (string, error)    { return contracts.RenderDocument(doc) }
+func updateDoc(root, path string, mutate func(*contracts.Document) error) error {
+	s, e := textFile(root, path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	if e = mutate(&d); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	s, e = render(d)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return writeFile(root, path, s)
+}
+func archiveQueue(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	q, e := project.Queue(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	entries, e := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive"))
+	if e != nil && !os.IsNotExist(e) {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	for _, ent := range entries {
+		if ent.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(ent.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		path := "changes/archive/" + ent.Name()
+		s, e := textFile(root, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil, e
+		}
+		q = append(q, project.Change{Path: path, Slug: slug(ent.Name()), Module: frontString(d.Frontmatter["module"]), Document: d})
+	}
+	return q, nil
+}
+func slug(name string) string {
+	name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(name), ".md")
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(name, '-'); i >= 0 && i+1 < len(name) {
+		return name[i+1:]
+	}
+	return name
+}
+func selectChange(root, selector string, archive bool) (project.Change, error) {
+	var all []project.Change
+	var e error
+	if archive {
+		all, e = archiveQueue(root)
+	} else {
+		all, e = project.Queue(root)
+	}
+	if e != nil {
+		return project.Change{}, e
+	}
+	valid := []string{}
+	matches := []project.Change{}
+	for _, ch := range all {
+		valid = append(valid, ch.Slug)
+		if selector == ch.Slug || selector == ch.Path || selector == filepath.Base(ch.Path) {
+			matches = append(matches, ch)
+		}
+	}
+	if len(matches) != 1 {
+		return project.Change{}, code("U02", "change %q not found or ambiguous; valid slugs: %s", selector, strings.Join(valid, ", "))
+	}
+	return matches[0], nil
+}
+func state(root string, ch project.Change, c claim, oid string) (model.State, error) {
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	for _, v := range q {
+		if v.Path == ch.Path {
+			ch = v
+			break
+		}
+	}
+	return model.State{Change: ch, Snapshot: c.Snapshot, Run: c.Run, Phase: c.Phase, Head: head, PhaseBase: c.PhaseBase, ClaimOID: oid}, nil
+}
+func owned(root string, selector string) (project.Change, claim, string, error) {
+	var ch project.Change
+	var e error
+	if selector == "" {
+		q, qe := project.Queue(root)
+		if qe != nil {
+			return ch, claim{}, "", qe
+		}
+		for _, candidate := range q {
+			c, oid, ok, re := readClaim(root, candidate)
+			if re != nil {
+				return ch, claim{}, "", re
+			}
+			if ok && c.Worktree == root {
+				return candidate, c, oid, nil
+			}
+		}
+		return ch, claim{}, "", code("P02", "worktree holds no change")
+	}
+	ch, e = selectChange(root, selector, false)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ch, claim{}, "", e
+	}
+	c, oid, ok, e := readClaim(root, ch)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ch, c, oid, e
+	}
+	if !ok {
+		return ch, c, oid, code("P02", "change has no claim")
+	}
+	if c.Worktree != root {
+		return ch, c, oid, code("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
+	}
+	return ch, c, oid, nil
+}
+func Current(root, selector string) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	return state(r, ch, c, oid)
+}
+func Release(root, selector string) error {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	ch, _, oid, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+}
+func depends(mods []project.Module, from, to string) bool {
+	seen := map[string]bool{}
+	var walk func(string) bool
+	walk = func(n string) bool {
+		if seen[n] {
+			return false
+		}
+		seen[n] = true
+		for _, m := range mods {
+			if m.Name == n {
+				for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+					if d == to || walk(d) {
+						return true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		return false
+	}
+	return walk(from)
+}
+func waiting(root string, q []project.Change, i int) (string, string) {
+	candidate := q[i]
+	if frontString(candidate.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(root, candidate.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", ""
+	}
+	for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
+		block := q[j]
+		if frontString(block.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if candidate.Module == block.Module {
+			return block.Slug, "same_module"
+		}
+		if depends(snap.Modules, candidate.Module, block.Module) {
+			return block.Slug, "depends_on_blocked"
+		}
+		iface, _ := contracts.Section(candidate.Document.Body, "Interface")
+		if strings.TrimSpace(iface) != "" && depends(snap.Modules, block.Module, candidate.Module) {
+			return block.Slug, "interface_dependency"
+		}
+	}
+	return "", ""
+}
+func Eligible(root string) ([]project.Change, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []project.Change{}
+	for i, ch := range q {
+		if frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"]) != "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		on, _ := waiting(r, q, i)
+		if on == "" {
+			out = append(out, ch)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func start(root, selector string, attempt int, resume bool) (model.State, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	var ch project.Change
+	if selector != "" {
+		ch, e = selectChange(r, selector, false)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	if resume {
+		if attempt <= 0 {
+			return model.State{}, code("P01", "invalid attempt %d", attempt)
+		}
+		name := "refs/fireweed/attempts/" + ch.Slug + "/" + strconv.Itoa(attempt)
+		_, ok, re := gitstore.Ref(r, name)
+		if re != nil {
+			return model.State{}, re
+		}
+		if !ok {
+			return model.State{}, code("P01", "attempt %s not found", name)
+		}
+	}
+	isDirty, e := dirty(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if isDirty {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "start requires clean worktree")
+	}
+	eligible, e := Eligible(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if len(eligible) == 0 {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "no eligible change")
+	}
+	if selector == "" {
+		ch = eligible[0]
+	} else if ch.Path != eligible[0].Path {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "change is not eligible queue head")
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		status, se := Status(r)
+		if se == nil {
+			config, _ := project.Load(r)
+			max := frontInt(nested(config.Config, "authoring")["max_unapproved"])
+			if max <= 0 {
+				max = 5
+			}
+			if status.Unapproved >= max {
+				return model.State{Diagnostics: []project.Diagnostic{{Code: "P07", Message: fmt.Sprintf("unapproved archives %d reached limit %d", status.Unapproved, max)}}}, code("P07", "unapproved archives reached limit")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if c, _, ok, re := readClaim(r, ch); re != nil {
+		return model.State{}, re
+	} else if ok {
+		return model.State{}, code("P02", "claim already held: %s: update-ref", c.Worktree)
+	}
+	head, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	original, e := textFile(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	s := original
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if resume && frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]) == "" {
+		return model.State{}, code("P01", "attempt requires committed phase")
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		if e = validateBases(r, ch); e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		s, e = assignIDs(r, ch, s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+		doc, e = contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil {
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	}
+	phase := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"])
+	run := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["run"])
+	if phase == "" {
+		phase = "evals"
+		if len(ch.Added)+len(ch.Modified)+len(ch.Removed) == 0 && len(list(doc.Frontmatter["fixes"])) == 0 && len(list(doc.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) == 0 {
+			phase = "impl"
+		}
+		if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+			phase = "impl"
+		}
+	}
+	if run == "" {
+		run = runID()
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = phase
+	doc.Frontmatter["run"] = run
+	s, e = render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(r, ch.Path, s); e != nil {
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Project(r, ch.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		_ = writeFile(r, ch.Path, original)
+		if strings.Contains(e.Error(), "stale base") { return model.State{}, code("P05", "%v", e) }
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	snap.Root = r
+	c := claim{Worktree: r, Change: ch.Slug, Run: run, Phase: phase, PhaseBase: head, Approved: s, Snapshot: snap}
+	oid, e := saveClaim(r, ch, c, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		_ = writeFile(r, ch.Path, original)
+		return model.State{}, e
+	}
+	if resume {
+		e = restoreAttempt(r, ch, attempt, s)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+			return model.State{}, e
+		}
+	} else if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+		_ = deleteDisposable(r, ch, snap)
+	}
+	st, e := state(r, ch, c, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return st, e
+	}
+	if !resume {
+		config, _ := project.Load(r)
+		remote, base := frontString(config.Config["remote"]), frontString(config.Config["base"])
+		if remote == "" {
+			remote = "origin"
+		}
+		if base == "" {
+			base = "main"
+		}
+		_, le := gitstore.ReadAt(r, "refs/heads/"+base, ch.Path)
+		_, se := gitstore.ReadAt(r, "refs/remotes/"+remote+"/"+base, ch.Path)
+		localHas, sharedHas := le == nil, se == nil
+		if !localHas && !sharedHas {
+			st.Diagnostics = append(st.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P04", Message: "change is not on local or shared base", Warning: true})
+		}
+		if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) && !newerPassingDrill(r, ch.Module) {
+			st.Diagnostics = append(st.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P10", Message: "regenerate has no newer passing drill", Warning: true})
+		}
+	}
+	return st, nil
+}
+func Start(root, selector string) (model.State, error) { return start(root, selector, 0, false) }
+func StartFromAttempt(root, selector string, n int) (model.State, error) {
+	return start(root, selector, n, true)
+}
+func validateBases(root string, ch project.Change) error {
+	stale, e := project.StaleSpecs(root, ch.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		if strings.Contains(e.Error(), "stale base") {
+			return code("P05", "%v", e)
+		}
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, s := range stale {
+		if !s.Recovered {
+			return code("P05", "stale base for %s", s.ID)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func newerPassingDrill(root, module string) bool {
+	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive"))
+	latest := time.Time{}
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		s, e := textFile(root, "changes/archive/"+entry.Name())
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e == nil && frontString(d.Frontmatter["module"]) == module {
+			if t := implDate(d); t.After(latest) {
+				latest = t
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	s, e := textFile(root, ".fireweed/drills/"+module+".md")
+	if e != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if frontString(d.Frontmatter["result"]) != "pass" {
+		return false
+	}
+	t := frontTime(d.Frontmatter["date"])
+	return !t.IsZero() && t.After(latest)
+}
+func assignIDs(root string, ch project.Change, s string) (string, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Added"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	if len(items) == 0 {
+		return s, nil
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return s, e
+	}
+	prefix := ""
+	used := map[int]bool{}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		prefix = m.IDPrefix
+		for _, it := range mustItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")) {
+			var n int
+			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(it.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
+				used[n] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	q, _ := project.Queue(root)
+	for _, other := range q {
+		for _, it := range other.Added {
+			var n int
+			if _, e := fmt.Sscanf(it.ID, prefix+"-%d", &n); e == nil {
+				used[n] = true
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(it.ID, "new:") {
+			continue
+		}
+		n := 1
+		for used[n] {
+			n++
+		}
+		used[n] = true
+		s = strings.ReplaceAll(s, it.ID, fmt.Sprintf("%s-%03d", prefix, n))
+	}
+	return s, nil
+}
+func section(body, name string) string    { s, _ := contracts.Section(body, name); return s }
+func mustItems(s string) []contracts.Item { it, _ := contracts.ParseItems(s); return it }
+func deleteDisposable(root string, ch project.Change, snap project.Snapshot) error {
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		return filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+			if e != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			if d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), p)
+			if contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones) == "disposable" {
+				return os.Remove(p)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func restoreAttempt(root string, ch project.Change, n int, approved string) error {
+	ref := "refs/fireweed/attempts/" + ch.Slug + "/" + strconv.Itoa(n)
+	files, e := git(root, "diff", "--name-only", ref+"^1", ref)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, path := range strings.Split(files, "\n") {
+		if path == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if path == ch.Path {
+			old, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, ref, path)
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(old))
+			if e != nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			cur, _ := contracts.ParseDocument(approved)
+			if s, ok := contracts.Section(d.Body, "Audit"); ok {
+				cur.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(cur.Body, "Audit", s)
+			}
+			text, e := render(cur)
+			if e == nil {
+				_ = writeFile(root, path, text)
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, ref, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, path))
+			continue
+		}
+		_ = writeFile(root, path, string(b))
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func sortedKeys(m map[string]any) []string {
+	k := make([]string, 0, len(m))
+	for a := range m {
+		k = append(k, a)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(k)
+	return k
+}
+
+var _ = errors.New
+var _ = context.Background
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..61a525268577e7ffe33c8e223645ad63dcf2d230
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/done.go
@@ -0,0 +1,296 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/assets"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func Done(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	req.Quick = false
+	out, e := verify(ctx, req)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	before, e := textFile(root, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(before)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	next := ""
+	blocked := false
+	switch c.Phase {
+	case "evals":
+		next = "audit"
+		audit := nested(c.Snapshot.Config, "audit")
+		if enabled, ok := audit["enabled"].(bool); ok && !enabled {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+	case "audit":
+		body, untestable, ae := auditSubmission(ch, c)
+		if ae != nil {
+			return out, ae
+		}
+		doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Audit", body)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(body, "-") {
+			rounds := frontInt(doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])
+			max := 2
+			if n := frontInt(nested(c.Snapshot.Config, "audit")["max_rounds"]); n > 0 {
+				max = n
+			}
+			if untestable || rounds >= max {
+				blocked = true
+				next = c.Phase
+				doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = "audit findings"
+				doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Questions", body)
+			} else {
+				next = "evals"
+				doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"] = rounds + 1
+			}
+		} else {
+			next = "impl"
+		}
+	case "impl":
+		next = "applied"
+	default:
+		return out, code("P01", "unsupported phase %s", c.Phase)
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["phase"] = next
+	line := provenance(c, req, out.Reports)
+	previous := section(doc.Body, "Provenance")
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Provenance", strings.TrimSpace(previous+"\n"+line)+"\n")
+	text, e := render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(root, ch.Path, text); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	var specPath, specBefore string
+	if next == "applied" {
+		for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if m.Name == ch.Module {
+				specPath = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(m.Dir, "SPEC.md"))
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if specPath == "" {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, code("C01", "module %s missing", ch.Module)
+		}
+		specBefore, e = textFile(root, specPath)
+		if e != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, e
+		}
+		newSpec, ae := applySpec(specBefore, ch)
+		if ae != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, ae
+		}
+		if e = writeFile(root, specPath, newSpec); e != nil {
+			_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+			return out, e
+		}
+		archived := "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+		if e = os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "changes", "archive"), 0755); e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		if e = os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, ch.Path), filepath.Join(root, archived)); e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		for _, d := range project.Check(root) {
+			if !d.Warning {
+				_ = os.Rename(filepath.Join(root, archived), filepath.Join(root, ch.Path))
+				_ = writeFile(root, specPath, specBefore)
+				_ = writeFile(root, ch.Path, before)
+				return out, code(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(root, "commit", "-m", fmt.Sprintf("fireweed %s %s", ch.Slug, c.Phase)); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	head, e := git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	c.Phase = next
+	c.PhaseBase = head
+	c.Approved = text
+	if next == "applied" || blocked {
+		_ = releaseClaim(root, ch, oid)
+		out.State.ClaimOID = ""
+		if next == "applied" {
+			ch.Path = "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+		}
+	} else {
+		oid, e = saveClaim(root, ch, c, oid)
+		if e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		out.State.ClaimOID = oid
+	}
+	out.State.Change = ch
+	out.State.Change.Document = doc
+	out.State.Phase = next
+	out.State.PhaseBase = head
+	out.State.Head = head
+	if blocked {
+		return out, code("P06", "change blocked")
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+func applySpec(source string, ch project.Change) (string, error) {
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(source)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	items, e := contracts.ParseItems(section(doc.Body, "Specs"))
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	byID := map[string]contracts.Item{}
+	order := []string{}
+	for _, it := range items {
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+		order = append(order, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range ch.Removed {
+		delete(byID, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range append(ch.Modified, ch.Added...) {
+		if _, ok := byID[it.ID]; !ok {
+			order = append(order, it.ID)
+		}
+		byID[it.ID] = it
+	}
+	sort.Strings(order)
+	unique := map[string]bool{}
+	lines := []string{}
+	for _, id := range order {
+		if unique[id] {
+			continue
+		}
+		unique[id] = true
+		if it, ok := byID[id]; ok {
+			lines = append(lines, strings.TrimSpace(contracts.RenderItem(it)))
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Specs", strings.Join(lines, "\n\n")+"\n")
+	if set := nested(ch.Document.Frontmatter, "set"); len(set) > 0 {
+		for k, v := range set {
+			doc.Frontmatter[k] = v
+		}
+	}
+	decisions := strings.TrimSpace(section(doc.Body, "Decisions"))
+	removed := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Removed decisions"))
+	if removed != "" {
+		for _, entry := range strings.Split(removed, "\n") {
+			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
+			if entry != "" {
+				decisions = strings.ReplaceAll(decisions, entry, "")
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	added := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Decisions"))
+	if added != "" {
+		for _, entry := range strings.Split(added, "\n") {
+			entry = strings.TrimSpace(entry)
+			if entry != "" {
+				if decisions != "" {
+					decisions += "\n"
+				}
+				decisions += "- " + ch.Slug + ": " + entry
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", strings.TrimSpace(decisions)+"\n")
+	return render(doc)
+}
+
+func Context(root, selector string, full bool) (string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	ch, c, _, e := owned(r, selector)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	change, e := textFile(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString("# Change\n" + change + "\n# Projected spec\n")
+	for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+		if m.Name != ch.Module {
+			continue
+		}
+		v, _ := render(m.Document)
+		b.WriteString(v + "\n")
+		for _, pattern := range m.Zones.Interface {
+			_ = pattern
+		}
+		_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r, m.Dir), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(r, p)
+			name := filepath.ToSlash(rel)
+			sub := strings.TrimPrefix(name, m.Dir+"/")
+			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(sub, m.Zones)
+			if zone == "interface" {
+				v, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
+				b.WriteString("\n## " + name + "\n" + string(v))
+				return nil
+			}
+			if sub == "SPEC.md" {
+				return nil
+			}
+			info, _ := d.Info()
+			if info == nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n%s %d bytes\n", name, info.Size()))
+			if full {
+				v, _ := os.ReadFile(p)
+				b.Write(v)
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+	}
+	system, _ := textFile(r, "SYSTEM.md")
+	b.WriteString("\n# SYSTEM\n" + system)
+	bookName := c.Phase
+	if c.Phase == "impl" && frontBool(ch.Document.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+		bookName = "regenerate"
+	}
+	book, _ := assets.Playbook(bookName)
+	b.WriteString("\n" + book)
+	return b.String(), nil
+}

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..220de39a53b60faa4e60cf200f4990802250745d

@@ -0,0 +1,285 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func phaseAt(root, rev, name string) string {
+	for _, path := range []string{"changes/" + name, "changes/archive/" + name} {
+		b, e := gitstore.ReadAt(root, rev, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(b))
+		if e == nil {
+			return frontString(d.Frontmatter["phase"])
+		}
+	}
+	return ""
+}
+func Commits(root, selector string) ([]string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	ch, e := selectChange(r, selector, true)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	output, e := git(r, "rev-list", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []string{}
+	name := filepath.Base(ch.Path)
+	for _, oid := range strings.Fields(output) {
+		parent, _ := git(r, "rev-parse", oid+"^1")
+		if parent == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		a, b := phaseAt(r, oid, name), phaseAt(r, parent, name)
+		if a != "" && a != b {
+			out = append(out, oid)
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+func Abandon(root, selector string) (string, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	ch, e := selectChange(r, selector, true)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	isDirty, e := dirty(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if isDirty {
+		return "", code("P01", "abandon requires clean worktree")
+	}
+	if strings.Contains(ch.Path, "/archive/") {
+		return "", code("P01", "applied archived change cannot be abandoned")
+	}
+	_, oid, ok, e := readClaim(r, ch)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if ok {
+		c, _, _, _ := readClaim(r, ch)
+		if c.Worktree != r {
+			return "", code("P02", "claim belongs to another worktree")
+		}
+	}
+	commits, e := Commits(r, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	for _, commit := range commits {
+		paths, _ := git(r, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", commit)
+		for _, path := range strings.Split(paths, "\n") {
+			if path == "" || path == ch.Path || strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/archive/") {
+				continue
+			}
+			if _, readErr := gitstore.ReadAt(r, commit+"^1", path); readErr != nil {
+				_, _ = git(r, "rm", "-f", "--", path)
+			} else {
+				_, _ = git(r, "restore", "--source="+commit+"^1", "--staged", "--worktree", "--", path)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if e = os.Remove(filepath.Join(r, ch.Path)); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "commit", "-m", "fireweed abandon "+ch.Slug); e != nil {
+		return "", e
+	}
+	if ok {
+		_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+	}
+	return git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+}
+func Block(req model.BlockRequest) (model.BlockResult, error) {
+	var out model.BlockResult
+	r, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(r, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	head, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if head != c.PhaseBase {
+		return out, code("P05", "phase base changed")
+	}
+	if e = approvedCheck(r, ch, c); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	n := 1
+	for {
+		_, ok, e := gitstore.Ref(r, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"+ch.Slug+"/"+strconv.Itoa(n))
+		if e != nil {
+			return out, e
+		}
+		if !ok {
+			break
+		}
+		n++
+	}
+	name := "refs/fireweed/attempts/" + ch.Slug + "/" + strconv.Itoa(n)
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "-A"); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	tree, e := git(r, "write-tree")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	attempt, e := git(r, "commit-tree", tree, "-p", head, "-m", "fireweed attempt "+ch.Slug)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = gitstore.CASRef(r, name, "", attempt); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.AttemptRef = name
+	out.AttemptOID = attempt
+	if _, e = git(r, "reset", "--hard", head); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	_, _ = git(r, "clean", "-fd")
+	doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(c.Approved)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	doc.Frontmatter["blocked"] = req.Reason
+	s, e := render(doc)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = writeFile(r, ch.Path, s); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "add", "--", ch.Path); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if _, e = git(r, "commit", "-m", "fireweed block "+ch.Slug); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	_ = releaseClaim(r, ch, oid)
+	head, e = git(r, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	c.PhaseBase = head
+	out.State, e = state(r, ch, c, "")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.State.Change.Document = doc
+	return out, nil
+}
+func GC(ctx context.Context, req model.GCRequest) (model.GCResult, error) {
+	_ = ctx
+	out := model.GCResult{Pruned: []string{}}
+	r, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	max := 720 * time.Hour
+	if raw := frontString(nested(snap.Config, "gc")["drill_max_age"]); raw != "" {
+		max, e = time.ParseDuration(raw)
+		if e != nil || max <= 0 {
+			return out, code("C01", "invalid gc.drill_max_age %q", raw)
+		}
+	}
+	now := req.Now
+	if now.IsZero() {
+		now = time.Now().UTC()
+	}
+	refs, e := git(r, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)", "refs/fireweed")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	registered, _ := git(r, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
+	worktrees := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(registered, "\n") {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "worktree ") {
+			p, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "worktree "))
+			worktrees[p] = true
+		}
+	}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(refs, "\n") {
+		parts := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(parts) != 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		name, oid := parts[0], parts[1]
+		remove := false
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/claims/") {
+			b, e := gitstore.ReadBlob(r, oid)
+			if e == nil {
+				var c claim
+				if json.Unmarshal(b, &c) == nil {
+					p, _ := filepath.EvalSymlinks(c.Worktree)
+					remove = !worktrees[p]
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/attempts/") {
+			bits := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/attempts/"), "/")
+			if len(bits) == 2 {
+				n, e := strconv.Atoi(bits[1])
+				if e == nil && n > 0 {
+					entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(r, "changes", "archive"))
+					for _, ent := range entries {
+						if slug(ent.Name()) == bits[0] {
+							remove = true
+							break
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/drills/") {
+			bits := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "refs/fireweed/drills/"), "/")
+			if len(bits) == 2 {
+				date, e := time.Parse("20060102T150405.000000000", bits[1])
+				if e == nil && date.Before(now.Add(-max)) {
+					remove = true
+				}
+			}
+		}
+		if remove {
+			if gitstore.CASRef(r, name, oid, "") == nil {
+				out.Pruned = append(out.Pruned, name)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(out.Pruned)
+	return out, nil
+}
diff --git a/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/reports.go b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/reports.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..be1a037fa2cfd2738f39a2e49fc84abec83c9970
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/workflow/internal/lifecycle/reports.go
@@ -0,0 +1,384 @@
+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/gitstore"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
+	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow/model"
+)
+
+func exceptions(mods []project.Module) ([]model.Quarantine, []model.BoundaryOptOut) {
+	q := []model.Quarantine{}
+	b := []model.BoundaryOptOut{}
+	for _, m := range mods {
+		if reason := frontString(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]); reason != "" {
+			b = append(b, model.BoundaryOptOut{Module: m.Name, Reason: reason})
+		}
+		for _, it := range mustItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")) {
+			if i := strings.Index(it.Tag, "quarantine:"); i >= 0 {
+				q = append(q, model.Quarantine{Module: m.Name, ID: it.ID, Reason: strings.TrimSpace(it.Tag[i+len("quarantine:"):])})
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return q, b
+}
+func implDate(doc contracts.Document) time.Time {
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(section(doc.Body, "Provenance"), "\n") {
+		f := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(f) >= 3 && f[0] == "-" && f[1] == "impl" {
+			if t, e := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, f[2]); e == nil {
+				return t
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return time.Time{}
+}
+func Status(root string) (model.StatusReport, error) {
+	out := model.StatusReport{DriftSinceDrill: map[string]int{}, PhaseCommits: map[string]int{}}
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	snap, e := project.Load(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.Modules = snap.Modules
+	out.Quarantines, out.BoundaryOptOuts = exceptions(snap.Modules)
+	q, e := project.Queue(r)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	for i, ch := range q {
+		phase := frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["phase"])
+		if phase == "" {
+			phase = "queued"
+		}
+		blocked := frontString(ch.Document.Frontmatter["blocked"])
+		on, rule := waiting(r, q, i)
+		out.Queue = append(out.Queue, model.StatusEntry{Slug: ch.Slug, Path: ch.Path, Module: ch.Module, Phase: phase, Blocked: blocked, AuditRounds: frontInt(ch.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]), WaitingOn: on, WaitingRule: rule})
+	}
+	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(r, "changes", "archive"))
+	type applied struct {
+		module, path string
+		date         time.Time
+	}
+	appliedList := []applied{}
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
+			continue
+		}
+		name := entry.Name()
+		path := "changes/archive/" + name
+		s, e := textFile(r, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+		if e != nil || frontString(doc.Frontmatter["phase"]) != "applied" {
+			continue
+		}
+		module := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["module"])
+		appliedList = append(appliedList, applied{module, path, implDate(doc)})
+		commits, _ := Commits(r, path)
+		out.PhaseCommits[strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".md")] = len(commits)
+	}
+	sort.Slice(appliedList, func(i, j int) bool {
+		if appliedList[i].date.Equal(appliedList[j].date) {
+			return appliedList[i].path < appliedList[j].path
+		}
+		return appliedList[i].date.After(appliedList[j].date)
+	})
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		drill := time.Time{}
+		if s, e := textFile(r, ".fireweed/drills/"+m.Name+".md"); e == nil {
+			if d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s); e == nil {
+				drill = frontTime(d.Frontmatter["date"])
+			}
+		}
+		for _, a := range appliedList {
+			if a.module == m.Name && (drill.IsZero() || a.date.After(drill)) {
+				out.DriftSinceDrill[m.Name]++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if len(appliedList) >= 3 {
+		first := appliedList[0].module
+		n := 0
+		for _, a := range appliedList {
+			if a.module != first {
+				break
+			}
+			n++
+		}
+		if n >= 3 {
+			out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, project.Diagnostic{Code: "P08", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s has %d consecutive applied changes", first, n), Warning: true})
+		}
+	}
+	remote := frontString(snap.Config["remote"])
+	if remote == "" {
+		remote = "origin"
+	}
+	base := frontString(snap.Config["base"])
+	ref, _ := gitstore.BaseRef(r, remote, base)
+	for _, a := range appliedList {
+		if ref == "" {
+			out.Unapproved++
+			continue
+		}
+		name := filepath.Base(a.path)
+		_, archiveErr := gitstore.ReadAt(r, ref, a.path)
+		_, pendingErr := gitstore.ReadAt(r, ref, "changes/"+name)
+		if archiveErr != nil && pendingErr != nil {
+			out.Unapproved++
+		}
+	}
+	snapshots, _ := Costs(r)
+	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
+	warnings := map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, s := range snapshots {
+		for _, cost := range s.Modules {
+			latest[cost.Module] = cost
+			warnings[cost.Module] = s.Diagnostics
+		}
+	}
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		if cost, ok := latest[m.Name]; ok {
+			out.Costs = append(out.Costs, cost)
+			for _, d := range warnings[m.Name] {
+				found := false
+				for _, old := range out.Diagnostics {
+					if old == d {
+						found = true
+					}
+				}
+				if !found {
+					out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, d)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return out, nil
+}
+
+type endpointError struct{ cause error }
+
+func (e endpointError) Error() string      { return e.cause.Error() }
+func (e endpointError) Unwrap() error      { return e.cause }
+func IsEndpointConfigError(err error) bool { var e endpointError; return errors.As(err, &e) }
+func PRBody(root, revisionRange string) (model.PRBodyReport, error) {
+	out := model.PRBodyReport{}
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	parts := strings.Split(revisionRange, "..")
+	if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] == "" || parts[1] == "" {
+		return out, code("P01", "invalid range %q", revisionRange)
+	}
+	start, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[0]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, code("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	end, e := git(r, "rev-parse", "--verify", parts[1]+"^{commit}")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, code("P01", "resolve %q: %v", revisionRange, e)
+	}
+	snap, e := project.LoadAt(r, end)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, endpointError{e}
+	}
+	var b strings.Builder
+	b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("# Changes %s..%s\n\n", start, end))
+	diff, e := git(r, "diff", "--name-status", start, end)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	touched := map[string]bool{}
+	changedFiles := []string{}
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(diff, "\n") {
+		f := strings.Fields(line)
+		if len(f) < 2 {
+			continue
+		}
+		path := f[len(f)-1]
+		changedFiles = append(changedFiles, path)
+		if strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/") {
+			touched[filepath.Base(path)] = true
+		}
+	}
+	tree, e := git(r, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", end, "changes")
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	selected := []string{}
+	for _, path := range strings.Split(tree, "\n") {
+		if !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".md") || !touched[filepath.Base(path)] {
+			continue
+		}
+		selected = append(selected, path)
+	}
+	if len(selected) == 0 {
+		b.WriteString("No selected changes.\n")
+	}
+	for _, path := range selected {
+		raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, end, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		doc, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		module := frontString(doc.Frontmatter["module"])
+		kind := "spec"
+		if len(list(doc.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+			kind = "eval_fix"
+		} else if frontBool(doc.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+			kind = "regenerate"
+		} else if len(mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Added")))+len(mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Modified"))) == 0 {
+			kind = "maintenance"
+		}
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n## %s\n\nModule: %s; kind: %s; audit_rounds: %d\n", path, module, kind, frontInt(doc.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"])))
+		b.WriteString("\n" + section(doc.Body, "Provenance") + "\n" + section(doc.Body, "Decisions") + "\n" + section(doc.Body, "Removed decisions") + "\n")
+		for _, it := range append(mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Added")), mustItems(section(doc.Body, "Modified"))...) {
+			if strings.Contains(it.Tag, "review") {
+				b.WriteString("\n" + it.ID + " " + strings.TrimSpace(it.Body) + "\n")
+			}
+		}
+		// Earlier phase documents remain useful even when the selected range contains only implementation.
+		commits, _ := git(r, "rev-list", end)
+		historicalFiles := map[string]bool{}
+		for _, oid := range strings.Fields(commits) {
+			parent, _ := git(r,"rev-parse",oid+"^1")
+			if parent!="" && phaseAt(r,oid,filepath.Base(path))!=phaseAt(r,parent,filepath.Base(path)) {
+				paths,_:=git(r,"diff-tree","--no-commit-id","--name-only","-r",oid)
+				for _,name:=range strings.Split(paths,"\n"){if strings.HasPrefix(name,"packages/"+module+"/")||name=="workspace.lock"{historicalFiles[name]=true}}
+			}
+			for _, p := range []string{"changes/" + filepath.Base(path), "changes/archive/" + filepath.Base(path)} {
+				raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, oid, p)
+				if e != nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+				if e == nil {
+					audit := section(d.Body, "Audit")
+					if strings.Contains(audit, "finding") || strings.Contains(audit, "FINDING") {
+						b.WriteString("\n" + audit + "\n")
+					}
+				}
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		for _, file := range changedFiles {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(file, "packages/"+module+"/") || strings.HasSuffix(file, "workspace.lock") {
+				historicalFiles[file]=true
+			}
+		}
+		paths:=make([]string,0,len(historicalFiles));for name:=range historicalFiles{paths=append(paths,name)};sort.Strings(paths);for _,name:=range paths{b.WriteString("\n- "+name)}
+		b.WriteString("\n")
+	}
+	q, opts := exceptions(snap.Modules)
+	for _, v := range q {
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\nQuarantine: %s %s %s\n", v.Module, v.ID, v.Reason))
+	}
+	for _, v := range opts {
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\nBoundary opt-out: %s %s\n", v.Module, v.Reason))
+	}
+	for _, path := range strings.Split(tree, "\n") {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "changes/") || strings.Contains(path, "/archive/") {
+			continue
+		}
+		raw, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, end, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(string(raw))
+		if e == nil {
+			if reason := frontString(d.Frontmatter["blocked"]); reason != "" {
+				b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\nBlocked %s: %s\n", path, reason))
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	snapshots, _ := Costs(r)
+	latest := map[string]model.ModuleCost{}
+	ds := map[string][]project.Diagnostic{}
+	for _, s := range snapshots {
+		for _, c := range s.Modules {
+			latest[c.Module] = c
+			ds[c.Module] = s.Diagnostics
+		}
+	}
+	b.WriteString("\n## Costs\n\n| Module | Seconds | Cases per spec | Eval lines | Disposable lines |\n|---|---:|---|---:|---:|\n")
+	for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+		c, ok := latest[m.Name]
+		if !ok {
+			continue
+		}
+		ids := []string{}
+		for id := range c.CasesPerSpec {
+			ids = append(ids, id)
+		}
+		sort.Strings(ids)
+		cases := []string{}
+		for _, id := range ids {
+			cases = append(cases, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %d", id, c.CasesPerSpec[id]))
+		}
+		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("| %s | %g | %s | %d | %d |\n", m.Name, c.Seconds, strings.Join(cases, ", "), c.EvalLines, c.DisposableLines))
+		for _, d := range ds[m.Name] {
+			found := false
+			for _, old := range out.Diagnostics {
+				if old == d {
+					found = true
+				}
+			}
+			if !found {
+				out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, d)
+				b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("\n%s: %s\n", d.Code, d.Message))
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, path := range changedFiles {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "packages/") {
+			continue
+		}
+		var mod project.Module
+		ok := false
+		for _, m := range snap.Modules {
+			if strings.HasPrefix(path, m.Dir+"/") {
+				mod = m
+				ok = true
+				break
+			}
+		}
+		if !ok || contracts.ResolveZone(strings.TrimPrefix(path, mod.Dir+"/"), mod.Zones) != "disposable" {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, start, path); e == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		data, e := gitstore.ReadAt(r, end, path)
+		if e != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if len(data) <= 262144 && !strings.ContainsRune(string(data), 0) {
+			continue
+		}
+		d := project.Diagnostic{Code: "B04", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s %d bytes", path, len(data)), Warning: true}
+		out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, d)
+		b.WriteString("\nB04: " + d.Message + "\n")
+	}
+	out.Body = b.String()
+	return out, nil
+}

+package lifecycle
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"

+	"path/filepath"

+func approvedCheck(root string, ch project.Change, c claim) error {
+	now, e := textFile(root, ch.Path)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	a, e := contracts.ParseDocument(c.Approved)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	b, e := contracts.ParseDocument(now)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	for _, key := range []string{"run", "phase"} {
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(a.Frontmatter[key], b.Frontmatter[key]) {
+			return code("P03", "approved run or phase changed")
+		}
+	}
+	for _, key := range []string{"audit_rounds", "blocked"} {
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(a.Frontmatter[key], b.Frontmatter[key]) {
+			return code("P03", "approved audit state changed")
+		}
+	}
+	for _, key := range []string{"run", "phase", "audit_rounds", "blocked"} {
+		delete(a.Frontmatter, key)
+		delete(b.Frontmatter, key)
+	}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(a.Frontmatter, b.Frontmatter) {
+		return code("P03", "approved author metadata changed")
+	}
+	ab := a.Body
+	bb := b.Body
+	for _, key := range []string{"Audit", "Provenance", "Questions"} {
+		ab = contracts.ReplaceSection(ab, key, "")
+		bb = contracts.ReplaceSection(bb, key, "")
+	}
+	if strings.TrimSpace(ab) != strings.TrimSpace(bb) {
+		return code("P03", "approved author metadata changed")
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func zoneCheck(root string, ch project.Change, c claim) error {
+	changes, e := gitstore.Changes(root, c.PhaseBase)
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	known := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, change := range changes { known[change.Path] = true }
+	status, _ := git(root,"status","--porcelain=v1","--untracked-files=all")
+	for _,line := range strings.Split(status,"\n") { if strings.HasPrefix(line,"?? ") {path:=strings.TrimPrefix(line,"?? ");if !known[path] {changes=append(changes,gitstore.Change{Path:path,Status:"A"});known[path]=true}} }
+	iface := strings.TrimSpace(section(ch.Document.Body, "Interface")) != ""
+	ds := checks.Zones(checks.ZoneRequest{Snapshot: c.Snapshot, Module: ch.Module, Phase: c.Phase, ChangePath: ch.Path, Base: c.PhaseBase, InterfaceDeclared: iface, Changes: changes})
+	if len(list(ch.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+		for _, change := range changes {
+			path := change.Path
+			if path == ch.Path {
+				continue
+			}
+			ok := false
+			if c.Phase == "evals" {
+				for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+					if m.Name == ch.Module && strings.HasPrefix(path, m.Dir+"/") {
+						rel := strings.TrimPrefix(path, m.Dir+"/")
+						ok = contracts.ResolveZone(rel, m.Zones) == "evals"
+					}
+				}
+			}
+			if !ok {
+				return code("Z01", "eval_fix forbids %s in %s", path, c.Phase)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	for _, d := range ds {
+		if !d.Warning {
+			return code(d.Code, "%s", d.Message)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+func enforced(m project.Module) []contracts.Item {
+	all := mustItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs"))
+	out := []contracts.Item{}
+	for _, it := range all {
+		if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(it.Tag), "quarantine") {
+			out = append(out, it)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func moduleFor(s project.Snapshot, name string) (project.Module, bool) {
+	for _, m := range s.Modules {
+		if m.Name == name {
+			return m, true
+		}
+	}
+	return project.Module{}, false
+}
+func changedIDs(ch project.Change) []string {
+	out := []string{}
+	for _, it := range ch.Added {
+		out = append(out, it.ID)
+	}
+	for _, it := range ch.Modified {
+		out = append(out, it.ID)
+	}
+	out = append(out, list(ch.Document.Frontmatter["fixes"])...)
+	out = append(out, list(ch.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])...)
+	return out
+}
+func auditSubmission(ch project.Change, c claim) (string, bool, error) {
+	body := section(ch.Document.Body, "Audit")
+	checked := regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)Checked IDs:\s*([^\n]+)`).FindStringSubmatch(body)
+	noFind := strings.Contains(body, "No findings")
+	finding := regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^-\s*(?:\[untestable\]\s*)?([A-Z]+-\d+):\s*"([^"]+)"[^\n]*`).FindAllStringSubmatch(body, -1)
+	specs := map[string]string{}
+	for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+		if m.Name == ch.Module {
+			for _, it := range mustItems(section(m.Document.Body, "Specs")) {
+				specs[it.ID] = it.Body
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	retained := []string{}
+	untestable := false
+	prior := sectionFromApproved(c.Approved, "Audit")
+	for _, f := range finding {
+		if !strings.Contains(specs[f[1]], f[2]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		if frontInt(ch.Document.Frontmatter["audit_rounds"]) > 0 && !strings.Contains(prior, f[1]) {
+			continue
+		}
+		retained = append(retained, f[0])
+		if strings.Contains(f[0], "[untestable]") {
+			untestable = true
+		}
+	}
+	if len(retained) > 0 {
+		return strings.Join(retained, "\n") + "\n", untestable, nil
+	}
+	if !noFind || len(checked) < 2 {
+		return "", false, code("P09", "audit requires Checked IDs and No findings")
+	}
+	for _, id := range changedIDs(ch) {
+		if !strings.Contains(checked[1], id) {
+			return "", false, code("P09", "audit did not check %s", id)
+		}
+	}
+	return "No findings; checked " + strings.TrimSpace(checked[1]) + "\n", false, nil
+}
+func sectionFromApproved(s, key string) string {
+	d, e := contracts.ParseDocument(s)
+	if e != nil {
+		return ""
+	}
+	return section(d.Body, key)
+}
+func Verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) { return verify(ctx, req) }
+func verify(ctx context.Context, req model.Request) (model.Result, error) {
+	var out model.Result
+	root, e := canonical(req.Root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	ch, c, oid, e := owned(root, req.Change)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	st, e := state(root, ch, c, oid)
+	if e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	out.State = st
+	out.Reports = map[string]checks.Report{}
+	if c.Phase != "evals" && c.Phase != "impl" && c.Phase != "audit" {
+		return out, code("P01", "unsupported phase %s", c.Phase)
+	}
+	if e = approvedCheck(root, ch, c); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = validateBases(root, ch); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if e = zoneCheck(root, ch, c); e != nil {
+		return out, e
+	}
+	if c.Phase == "audit" {
+		_, _, e = auditSubmission(ch, c)
+		return out, e
+	}
+	target, ok := moduleFor(c.Snapshot, ch.Module)
+	if !ok {
+		return out, code("C01", "module %s not found", ch.Module)
+	}
+	modules := []project.Module{target}
+	if c.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		choice := frontString(c.Snapshot.Config["verify_dependents"])
+		if choice == "" {
+			choice = "direct"
+		}
+		for _, m := range c.Snapshot.Modules {
+			if m.Name == ch.Module {
+				continue
+			}
+			include := false
+			if choice == "all" {
+				include = depends(c.Snapshot.Modules, m.Name, ch.Module)
+			} else if choice == "direct" {
+				for _, d := range m.DependsOn {
+					if d == ch.Module {
+						include = true
+					}
+				}
+			}
+			if include {
+				modules = append(modules, m)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	var first error
+	for _, m := range modules {
+		report, err := checks.Evaluate(ctx, checks.HookRequest{Snapshot: c.Snapshot, Module: m.Name, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		out.Reports[m.Name] = report
+		_ = saveReport(root, c, m.Name, report)
+		specs := enforced(m)
+		if err == nil || len(report.Cases) > 0 {
+			if cov := checks.RequireCoverage(report, specs); cov != nil && first == nil {
+				first = cov
+			}
+		}
+		if m.Name == ch.Module && c.Phase == "evals" {
+			if len(list(ch.Document.Frontmatter["eval_fix"])) > 0 {
+				if pass := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); pass != nil && first == nil {
+					first = pass
+				}
+			} else {
+				if ff := checks.RequireFailFirst(report, changedIDs(ch), list(ch.Document.Frontmatter["already_satisfied"])); ff != nil && first == nil {
+					first = ff
+				}
+			}
+		} else if c.Phase == "impl" {
+			if pass := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); pass != nil && first == nil {
+				first = pass
+			}
+		}
+		if err != nil && first == nil {
+			first = err
+		}
+	}
+	out.Costs = moduleCosts(root, c, modules, out.Reports)
+	out.Diagnostics = budgetWarnings(c.Snapshot.Config, out.Costs)
+	_ = saveCosts(root, c, out.Costs, out.Diagnostics)
+	if c.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
+		ds, err := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: c.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
+		if err != nil {
+			out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, ds...)
+			if first == nil {
+				first = err
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return out, first
+}
+func saveReport(root string, c claim, name string, r checks.Report) error {
+	dir := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", c.Run, c.Phase)
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(r, "", "  ")
+	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".json"), b, 0644)
+}
+func saveCosts(root string, c claim, costs []model.ModuleCost, ds []project.Diagnostic) error {
+	dir := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", c.Run, c.Phase)
+	if e := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	v := model.CostSnapshot{Run: c.Run, Phase: c.Phase, RecordedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Modules: costs, Diagnostics: ds}
+	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
+	if e != nil {
+		return e
+	}
+	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "costs.json"), b, 0644)
+}
+func moduleCosts(root string, c claim, modules []project.Module, reports map[string]checks.Report) []model.ModuleCost {
+	out := []model.ModuleCost{}
+	for _, m := range modules {
+		r := reports[m.Name]
+		v := model.ModuleCost{Module: m.Name, CasesPerSpec: map[string]int{}}
+		for _, it := range enforced(m) {
+			v.CasesPerSpec[it.ID] = 0
+		}
+		for _, tc := range r.Cases {
+			v.Seconds += tc.Seconds
+			for _, id := range tc.IDs {
+				v.CasesPerSpec[id]++
+			}
+		}
+		_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, e error) error {
+			if e != nil || d.IsDir() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			info, e := d.Info()
+			if e != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+				return nil
+			}
+			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(root, m.Dir), p)
+			zone := contracts.ResolveZone(filepath.ToSlash(rel), m.Zones)
+			if zone != "evals" && zone != "disposable" {
+				return nil
+			}
+			b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
+			if e != nil {
+				return nil
+			}
+			n := strings.Count(string(b), "\n")
+			if len(b) > 0 && b[len(b)-1] != '\n' {
+				n++
+			}
+			if zone == "evals" {
+				v.EvalLines += n
+			} else {
+				v.DisposableLines += n
+			}
+			return nil
+		})
+		out = append(out, v)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func budgetWarnings(config map[string]any, costs []model.ModuleCost) []project.Diagnostic {
+	b := nested(config, "budgets")
+	limitSeconds := 900.0
+	if raw := frontString(b["verify_time"]); raw != "" {
+		if d, e := time.ParseDuration(raw); e == nil {
+			limitSeconds = d.Seconds()
+		}
+	}
+	cases := 15
+	if n := frontInt(b["cases_per_spec"]); n > 0 {
+		cases = n
+	}
+	ratio := 4.0
+	if n := frontInt(b["eval_ratio"]); n > 0 {
+		ratio = float64(n)
+	}
+	out := []project.Diagnostic{}
+	total := 0.0
+	for _, m := range costs {
+		total += m.Seconds
+		for id, n := range m.CasesPerSpec {
+			if n > cases {
+				out = append(out, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B02", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s %s cases %d exceeds limit %d", m.Module, id, n, cases), Warning: true})
+			}
+		}
+		if m.EvalLines > 0 && (m.DisposableLines == 0 || float64(m.EvalLines)/float64(m.DisposableLines) > ratio) {
+			out = append(out, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B03", Message: fmt.Sprintf("%s eval/disposable ratio %d/%d exceeds limit %g", m.Module, m.EvalLines, m.DisposableLines, ratio), Warning: true})
+		}
+	}
+	if total > limitSeconds {
+		out = append(out, project.Diagnostic{Code: "B01", Message: fmt.Sprintf("verification seconds %g exceeds limit %g", total, limitSeconds), Warning: true})
+	}
+	return out
+}
+func Costs(root string) ([]model.CostSnapshot, error) {
+	r, e := canonical(root)
+	if e != nil {
+		return nil, e
+	}
+	out := []model.CostSnapshot{}
+	_ = filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(r, ".fireweed", "runs"), func(p string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		if d.IsDir() || d.Name() != "costs.json" {
+			return nil
+		}
+		b, e := os.ReadFile(p)
+		if e != nil {
+			return nil
+		}
+		var s model.CostSnapshot
+		if json.Unmarshal(b, &s) == nil {
+			out = append(out, s)
+		}
+		return nil
+	})
+	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].RecordedAt.Before(out[j].RecordedAt) })
+	return out, nil
+}
+func provenance(c claim, req model.Request, reports map[string]checks.Report) string {
+	agent := req.Agent
+	if agent == "" {
+		agent = "manual"
+	}
+	book, _ := assets.Playbook(c.Phase)
+	if c.Phase == "impl" {
+		d, _ := contracts.ParseDocument(c.Approved)
+		if frontBool(d.Frontmatter["regenerate"]) {
+			book, _ = assets.Playbook("regenerate")
+		}
+	}
+	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(book))
+	total, fail, pass := 0, 0, 0
+	for _, r := range reports {
+		for _, tc := range r.Cases {
+			total++
+			if tc.Result == "pass" {
+				pass++
+			} else if tc.Result == "fail" || tc.Result == "error" {
+				fail++
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("- %s %s agent=%s fireweed=%s playbook=%s tests=%d failing=%d passing=%d\n", c.Phase, time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), agent, assets.Version(), hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]), total, fail, pass)
+}

func Test_FLOW_098_ModuleJUnitCostsAndHeldZoneLineCounts(t *testing.T) {

	write(t, root, ".fireweed/eval.sh", `#!/bin/sh

  else failure='<failure/>'; code=1; fi

	commit(t, root, "held zone and multi-ID cost fixture")

		t.Fatalf("evals Done: %v", err)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/ready", "ready\n")
	result, err := verify(root, false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("full impl Verify: %v", err)
	}
	if cases := result.Reports["alpha"].Cases; len(cases) != 2 || !reflect.DeepEqual(cases[0].IDs, []string{"ALP-001", "ALP-002"}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(cases[1].IDs, []string{"ALP-001"}) || result.Reports["alpha"].Seconds != 1.75 || result.Reports["beta"].Seconds != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("cost fixture reports have unexpected cases or time: %#v", result.Reports)
	}
	if len(result.Costs) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("FLOW-098 costs for evaluated modules = %#v; want alpha and beta", result.Costs)
	}
	alpha, ok := costFor(result.Costs, "alpha")
	if !ok || alpha.Seconds != 1.75 || !reflect.DeepEqual(alpha.CasesPerSpec, map[string]int{"ALP-001": 2, "ALP-002": 1}) || alpha.EvalLines != 3 || alpha.DisposableLines != 3 {
		t.Errorf("FLOW-098 alpha cost = %#v, present %v; want seconds 1.75, counts 2/1, eval 3, disposable 3", alpha, ok)
	}
	beta, ok := costFor(result.Costs, "beta")
	if !ok || beta.Seconds != 2 || !reflect.DeepEqual(beta.CasesPerSpec, map[string]int{"BET-001": 1}) || beta.EvalLines != 1 || beta.DisposableLines != 1 {
		t.Errorf("FLOW-098 beta cost = %#v, present %v", beta, ok)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_099_CustomWarningsSurviveSuccessAndFailure(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "audit:\n  enabled: false\nbudgets:\n  verify_time: 3s\n  cases_per_spec: 1\n  eval_ratio: 1\n", "", "", "", "")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/weight.txt", "a\nb\n")

if [ "$1" = alpha ]; then
  if [ -f packages/alpha/internal/ready ]; then failure=''; code=0
  else failure='<failure/>'; code=1; fi
  printf '<testsuite><testcase name="ALP-001 first" time="1">%s</testcase><testcase name="ALP-001 second" time="1"/><testcase name="ALP-002" time="1"/></testsuite>' "$failure" > "$2"
  exit "$code"
fi
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="BET-001" time="1"><failure/></testcase></testsuite>' > "$2"

	}

		t.Errorf("FLOW-099 B01 at custom 3s threshold = %#v", d)
	}
	requireCostWarning(t, verified.Diagnostics, "B02", "ALP-001", "2", "1")
	requireCostWarning(t, verified.Diagnostics, "B03", "alpha", "1")
	if cost, ok := costFor(verified.Costs, "alpha"); !ok || cost.EvalLines != 2 || cost.DisposableLines != 0 {

	if head(t, root) != before {
		t.Error("failed impl Done committed")
	}
	if len(failed.Reports["beta"].Cases) != 1 {
		t.Errorf("failure fixture did not evaluate beta: %#v", failed.Reports)
	}
	for _, code := range []string{"B01", "B02", "B03"} {
		requireCostWarning(t, failed.Diagnostics, code)
	}
	requireCostWarning(t, failed.Diagnostics, "B01", "4", "3")
	if snapshot, ok := costAt(t, root, failed.State.Run, "impl"); ok {
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(snapshot.Modules, failed.Costs) {
			t.Errorf("FLOW-099 failed Done snapshot costs = %#v; result %#v", snapshot.Modules, failed.Costs)
		}
		for _, code := range []string{"B01", "B02", "B03"} {
			retained, found := warningFor(snapshot.Diagnostics, code)
			returned, present := warningFor(failed.Diagnostics, code)
			if !found || !present || retained != returned {
				t.Errorf("FLOW-099 %s failed Done retained warning = %#v; result %#v", code, retained, returned)
			}
		}
	}

func Test_FLOW_099_DefaultBudgetBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name  string
		cases int
		secs  int
		lines int
		warn  bool
	}{{"equal", 15, 900, 4, false}, {"above", 16, 901, 5, true}} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			root := fixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
			write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/weight.txt", strings.Repeat("line\n", tc.lines))
			write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/code.txt", "line\n")
			var cases strings.Builder
			for i := 0; i < tc.cases; i++ {
				seconds, failure := 0, ""
				if i == 0 {
					seconds, failure = tc.secs, "<failure/>"
				}
				fmt.Fprintf(&cases, `<testcase name="ALP-001 case %d" time="%d">%s</testcase>`, i, seconds, failure)
			}
			cases.WriteString(`<testcase name="ALP-002" time="0"/>`)
			write(t, root, ".fireweed/eval.sh", "#!/bin/sh\ncat > \"$2\" <<'XML'\n<testsuite>"+cases.String()+"</testsuite>\nXML\nexit 1\n")
			commit(t, root, "default budget boundary fixture")
			start(t, root)
			result, err := verify(root, true)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("boundary Verify: %v", err)
			}
			if report := result.Reports["alpha"]; len(report.Cases) != tc.cases+1 || report.Seconds != float64(tc.secs) {
				t.Fatalf("budget fixture JUnit = %#v; want %d cases and %ds", report, tc.cases+1, tc.secs)
			}
			for _, code := range []string{"B01", "B02", "B03"} {
				d, ok := warningFor(result.Diagnostics, code)
				if ok != tc.warn || ok && !d.Warning {
					t.Errorf("FLOW-099 %s at defaults (secs %d, cases %d, ratio %d) = %#v; want warning %v", code, tc.secs, tc.cases, tc.lines, result.Diagnostics, tc.warn)
				}
			}
			if tc.warn {
				requireCostWarning(t, result.Diagnostics, "B01")
				if d, _ := warningFor(result.Diagnostics, "B01"); !strings.Contains(d.Message, "901") && !strings.Contains(d.Message, "15m1s") {
					t.Errorf("FLOW-099 B01 warning omits measured 901s: %q", d.Message)
				}
				if d, _ := warningFor(result.Diagnostics, "B01"); !strings.Contains(d.Message, "900") && !strings.Contains(d.Message, "15m") {
					t.Errorf("FLOW-099 B01 warning omits default 15m limit: %q", d.Message)
				}
				requireCostWarning(t, result.Diagnostics, "B02", "ALP-001", "16", "15")
				requireCostWarning(t, result.Diagnostics, "B03", "alpha", "5", "4")
				completed, err := done(root)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("default warnings made evals Done fail: %v", err)
				}
				for _, code := range []string{"B01", "B02", "B03"} {
					requireCostWarning(t, completed.Diagnostics, code)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_100_CostsEmptyOrderedAndRetainedAfterEdits(t *testing.T) {
	root := fixture(t, "audit:\n  enabled: false\nbudgets:\n  eval_ratio: 1\n", "", "", "", "")
	initial, err := workflow.Costs(root)
	if err != nil || len(initial) != 0 {
		t.Errorf("FLOW-100 empty Costs = %#v, %v", initial, err)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/weight.txt", "one\ntwo\n")
	commit(t, root, "measured eval lines")
	state := start(t, root)
	evalsResult, err := done(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("evals Done: %v", err)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/ready", "ready\n")
	implResult, err := done(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("impl Done: %v", err)
	}
	snapshots, err := workflow.Costs(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Costs: %v", err)
	}
	if len(snapshots) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("FLOW-100 retained snapshots = %#v; want evals then impl", snapshots)
	} else {
		if snapshots[0].Run != state.Run || snapshots[0].Phase != "evals" || snapshots[1].Run != state.Run || snapshots[1].Phase != "impl" || snapshots[0].RecordedAt.After(snapshots[1].RecordedAt) {
			t.Errorf("FLOW-100 recording order/identity = %#v", snapshots)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(snapshots[0].Modules, evalsResult.Costs) || !reflect.DeepEqual(snapshots[1].Modules, implResult.Costs) {
			t.Errorf("FLOW-100 retained module values = %#v; Done costs %#v, %#v", snapshots, evalsResult.Costs, implResult.Costs)
		}
		for _, snapshot := range snapshots {
			requireCostWarning(t, snapshot.Diagnostics, "B03")
		}
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/weight.txt", "changed\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/internal/ready", "changed\ntoo\n")
	config, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "fireweed.yaml"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write(t, root, "fireweed.yaml", strings.Replace(string(config), "eval_ratio: 1", "eval_ratio: 100", 1))
	after, err := workflow.Costs(root)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(after, snapshots) {
		t.Errorf("FLOW-100 Costs changed after source/settings edits: before %#v, after %#v, err %v", snapshots, after, err)
	}
}

package evals_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/workflow"
)

func costAt(t *testing.T, root, run, phase string) (workflow.CostSnapshot, bool) {
	t.Helper()
	path := filepath.Join(root, ".fireweed", "runs", run, phase, "costs.json")
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Errorf("cost snapshot %s: %v", path, err)
		return workflow.CostSnapshot{}, false
	}
	var snapshot workflow.CostSnapshot
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &snapshot); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("decode cost snapshot %s: %v", path, err)
		return workflow.CostSnapshot{}, false
	}
	return snapshot, true
}

func costFor(costs []workflow.ModuleCost, name string) (workflow.ModuleCost, bool) {
	for _, cost := range costs {
		if cost.Module == name {
			return cost, true
		}
	}
	return workflow.ModuleCost{}, false
}

func warningFor(ds []project.Diagnostic, code string) (project.Diagnostic, bool) {
	for _, d := range ds {
		if d.Code == code {
			return d, true
		}
	}
	return project.Diagnostic{}, false
}

func requireCostWarning(t *testing.T, ds []project.Diagnostic, code string, terms ...string) {
	t.Helper()
	d, ok := warningFor(ds, code)
	if !ok || !d.Warning {
		t.Errorf("%s warning absent from %#v", code, ds)
		return
	}
	for _, term := range terms {
		if !strings.Contains(d.Message, term) {
			t.Errorf("%s warning %q does not identify %q", code, d.Message, term)
		}
	}
}

				}

					first = ff
				}
			}
		} else if c.Phase == "impl" {
			if pass := checks.RequirePass(report, specs); pass != nil && first == nil {
				first = pass
			}
		}
		if err != nil && first == nil {
			first = err
		}
	}
	out.Costs = moduleCosts(root, c, modules, out.Reports)
	out.Diagnostics = budgetWarnings(c.Snapshot.Config, out.Costs)
	_ = saveCosts(root, c, out.Costs, out.Diagnostics)
	if c.Phase == "impl" && !req.Quick {
		ds, err := checks.Boundaries(ctx, checks.BoundaryRequest{Snapshot: c.Snapshot, Bin: req.Bin, Timeout: req.Timeout})
		if err != nil {
			out.Diagnostics = append(out.Diagnostics, ds...)
			if first == nil {
				first = err
			}
		}
	}

package evals_test

import (
	"os"

// These fixtures use the public lifecycle to create a saved commit and release
// its claim. An author then commits the unblock before any resume request.
func unblockAttempt(t *testing.T, root string) {
	t.Helper()
	path := "changes/0001-manual.md"
	doc, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, path))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, blocked := doc.Frontmatter["blocked"]; !blocked {
		t.Fatal("fixture has no committed block to remove")
	}
	delete(doc.Frontmatter, "blocked")
	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Motivation", "\nAuthor approved a revised purpose.\n")
	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Interface", "\nAuthor approved the current interface.\n")
	rendered, err := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write(t, root, path, rendered)
	commit(t, root, "author unblocks saved attempt")
}

func savedEvalsAttempt(t *testing.T) (string, workflow.State, workflow.BlockResult) {
	t.Helper()
	root := blockFixture(t, "", "", "### new:extra\nExtra MUST be checked.\n", "", "")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/current_test.go", "original eval\n")
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/retired_test.go", "retired eval\n")
	commit(t, root, "fixture eval files")
	started := start(t, root)
	if started.Phase != "evals" || started.Run == "" || len(started.Change.Added) != 1 || started.Change.Added[0].ID != "ALP-003" {
		t.Fatalf("invalid assigned evals fixture: %#v", started)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/current_test.go", "saved modified eval\n")
	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "packages/alpha/evals/retired_test.go")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write(t, root, "packages/alpha/evals/new_test.go", "saved new eval\n")
	path := "changes/0001-manual.md"
	doc, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, path))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Decisions", "\nSaved worker decision.\n")
	doc.Body = contracts.ReplaceSection(doc.Body, "Questions", "\nSaved worker question.\n")
	rendered, err := contracts.RenderDocument(doc)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write(t, root, path, rendered)
	saved := block(t, root, "eval attempts exhausted")
	if saved.AttemptRef != "refs/fireweed/attempts/manual/1" || saved.AttemptOID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("Block did not save attempt 1: %#v", saved)
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain", "-uall"); got != "" {
		t.Fatalf("Block left checkout dirty: %s", got)
	}
	return root, started, saved
}

func assertNoResumeMutation(t *testing.T, root, beforeHead, beforeChange string) {
	t.Helper()
	if head(t, root) != beforeHead || readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md") != beforeChange {
		t.Error("rejected resume changed HEAD or change document")
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(objectname)", "refs/fireweed/claims/manual"); got != "" {
		t.Errorf("rejected resume claimed change: %s", got)
	}
	if got := git(t, root, "status", "--porcelain", "-uall"); got != "" {
		t.Errorf("rejected resume dirtied checkout: %s", got)
	}
}

		want, _ := contracts.Section(approved.Body, name)
		actual, _ := contracts.Section(resumed.Body, name)
		if actual != want {
			t.Errorf("current approved %s changed: got %q, want %q", name, actual, want)
		}
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(resumed.Frontmatter, approved.Frontmatter) {
		t.Errorf("current runtime/author frontmatter changed: got %#v, want %#v", resumed.Frontmatter, approved.Frontmatter)
	}
	for name, want := range map[string]string{"Decisions": "Saved worker decision.", "Questions": "Saved worker question."} {
		body, ok := contracts.Section(resumed.Body, name)
		if !ok || !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("saved worker %s absent: %q", name, body)
		}
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_074_StartFromAttemptSelectsRequestedSavedRef(t *testing.T) {

	second := block(t, root, "second eval attempt exhausted")
	if second.AttemptRef != "refs/fireweed/attempts/manual/2" || second.AttemptOID == "" || second.AttemptOID == first.AttemptOID {
		t.Fatalf("Block did not save a distinct attempt 2: first=%#v, second=%#v", first, second)

	}
	if got := git(t, root, "show", second.AttemptRef+":packages/alpha/evals/current_test.go"); got != "second modified eval" {
		t.Fatalf("attempt 2 content = %q", got)
	}
	unblockAttempt(t, root)
	if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 2); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("StartFromAttempt(%s): %v", second.AttemptRef, err)

		t.Errorf("requested attempt 2 new eval = %q", got)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_075_StartFromAttemptRestoresAuditBodyAndRetainsCurrentApproval(t *testing.T) {
	root := blockFixture(t, "", "", "", "", "")
	auditState := toAudit(t, root)
	path := "changes/0001-manual.md"
	committed, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, path))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	committedAudit, _ := contracts.Section(committed.Body, "Audit")
	audit(t, root, "Checked IDs: ALP-001\nNo findings\n")
	worker, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, path))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	savedAudit, ok := contracts.Section(worker.Body, "Audit")
	if !ok || savedAudit == committedAudit || !strings.Contains(savedAudit, "No findings") {
		t.Fatalf("fixture lacks distinct worker Audit body: saved=%q, committed=%q", savedAudit, committedAudit)
	}
	saved := block(t, root, "audit attempt exhausted")
	if saved.AttemptRef != "refs/fireweed/attempts/manual/1" || saved.AttemptOID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("Block did not save audit attempt: %#v", saved)
	}
	unblockAttempt(t, root)
	before, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, path))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	currentAudit, _ := contracts.Section(before.Body, "Audit")
	currentProvenance, hasProvenance := contracts.Section(before.Body, "Provenance")
	if currentAudit == savedAudit || !hasProvenance || strings.TrimSpace(currentProvenance) == "" {
		t.Fatalf("fixture lacks separate committed Audit or controller provenance: Audit=%q, Provenance=%q", currentAudit, currentProvenance)
	}
	got, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("audit StartFromAttempt(%s): %v", saved.AttemptRef, err)
	}
	if got.Phase != auditState.Phase || got.Run != auditState.Run {
		t.Errorf("audit resume changed phase or run: %#v", got)
	}
	resumed, err := contracts.ParseDocument(readFile(t, root, path))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if body, _ := contracts.Section(resumed.Body, "Audit"); body != savedAudit {
		t.Errorf("restored Audit = %q, want saved worker body %q", body, savedAudit)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"Motivation", "Interface", "Added", "Modified", "Removed", "Removed decisions", "Provenance"} {
		want, _ := contracts.Section(before.Body, name)
		actual, _ := contracts.Section(resumed.Body, name)
		if actual != want {
			t.Errorf("current %s changed: got %q, want %q", name, actual, want)
		}
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(resumed.Frontmatter, before.Frontmatter) {
		t.Errorf("audit resume changed current author/runtime frontmatter: got %#v, want %#v", resumed.Frontmatter, before.Frontmatter)
	}
}

func Test_FLOW_073_StartFromAttemptRequiresCleanEligibleUnblockedAndUnclaimedChange(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("dirty", func(t *testing.T) {
		root, _, _ := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
		unblockAttempt(t, root)
		write(t, root, "uncommitted.txt", "dirty\n")
		if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 1); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "P01") {
			t.Errorf("dirty resume = %v, want P01", err)
		}
		if got := git(t, root, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(objectname)", "refs/fireweed/claims/manual"); got != "" {
			t.Errorf("dirty resume created claim: %s", got)
		}
	})
	t.Run("still blocked", func(t *testing.T) {
		root, _, _ := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
		beforeHead, before := head(t, root), readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
		if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 1); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "P01") {
			t.Errorf("blocked resume = %v, want P01", err)
		}
		assertNoResumeMutation(t, root, beforeHead, before)
	})
	t.Run("not first eligible", func(t *testing.T) {
		root, _, _ := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
		unblockAttempt(t, root)
		write(t, root, "changes/0000-first.md", "---\nmodule: alpha\n---\n## Motivation\nEarlier approved work.\n\n## Interface\n\n## Added\n\n## Modified\n\n## Removed\n\n## Decisions\n")
		commit(t, root, "earlier eligible change")
		beforeHead, before := head(t, root), readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
		if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", 1); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "P01") {
			t.Errorf("waiting resume = %v, want P01", err)
		}
		assertNoResumeMutation(t, root, beforeHead, before)
	})
	t.Run("foreign claim", func(t *testing.T) {
		root, _, _ := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
		unblockAttempt(t, root)
		other := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "linked")
		git(t, root, "worktree", "add", "-b", "linked", other, "HEAD")
		owner := start(t, root)
		beforeHead, before := head(t, other), readFile(t, other, "changes/0001-manual.md")
		if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(other, "manual", 1); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "P02") {
			t.Errorf("foreign claim resume = %v, want P02", err)
		}
		if head(t, other) != beforeHead || readFile(t, other, "changes/0001-manual.md") != before {
			t.Error("foreign resume changed other worktree")
		}
		if current, err := workflow.Current(root, "manual"); err != nil || current.ClaimOID != owner.ClaimOID {
			t.Errorf("foreign resume changed owner's claim: %#v, %v", current, err)
		}
	})
}

func Test_FLOW_076_StartFromAttemptRejectsInvalidOrMissingAttemptBeforeMutation(t *testing.T) {
	root, _, _ := savedEvalsAttempt(t)
	unblockAttempt(t, root)
	beforeHead, before := head(t, root), readFile(t, root, "changes/0001-manual.md")
	for _, attempt := range []int{0, -1, 2} {
		if _, err := workflow.StartFromAttempt(root, "manual", attempt); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "P01") {
			t.Errorf("attempt %d = %v, want P01", attempt, err)
		}
		assertNoResumeMutation(t, root, beforeHead, before)
	}
}
